import LongTails.Proofs.MuonStochastic
import LongTails.Proofs.MuonExecution
import LongTails.Setups.MuonFrobenius

open MeasureTheory
open scoped RealInnerProductSpace

namespace OracleTemplate.Muon

theorem averaged_bound {Ξ : Type} [MeasurableSpace Ξ] (Q : Measure Ξ) [IsProbabilityMeasure Q]
    (T : ℕ) (hT : 1 ≤ T) (η c κ : ℝ) (hη : 0 < η) (hκ : 0 ≤ κ)
    (A F Er : ℕ → Ξ → ℝ) (e : ℕ → ℝ) (hA : ∀ t, Integrable (A t) Q) (hF : ∀ t, Integrable (F t) Q)
    (hE : ∀ t, Integrable (Er t) Q)
    (hpath : ∀ t ω, η * A t ω ≤ F t ω - F (t + 1) ω + c + κ * Er t ω)
    (he : ∀ t, (∫ ω, Er t ω ∂Q) ≤ e t) :
    (1 / (T : ℝ)) * ∑ t ∈ Finset.range T, (∫ ω, A t ω ∂Q) ≤
      (∫ ω, F 0 ω - F T ω ∂Q) / (T * η) + c / η + κ / η * ((1 / (T : ℝ)) * ∑ t ∈ Finset.range T, e t) := by
  have hTpos : (0 : ℝ) < T := by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < T by omega)
  have h1 : ∀ t, η * (∫ ω, A t ω ∂Q) ≤ (∫ ω, F t ω ∂Q) - (∫ ω, F (t + 1) ω ∂Q) + c + κ * e t := by
    intro t
    have i1 : Integrable (fun ω => F t ω - F (t + 1) ω) Q := (hF t).sub (hF (t + 1))
    have i2 : Integrable (fun ω => F t ω - F (t + 1) ω + c) Q := i1.add (integrable_const c)
    have i3 : Integrable (fun ω => κ * Er t ω) Q := (hE t).const_mul κ
    have hint : Integrable (fun ω => F t ω - F (t + 1) ω + c + κ * Er t ω) Q := i2.add i3
    have i0 : Integrable (fun ω => η * A t ω) Q := (hA t).const_mul η
    have hm := integral_mono i0 hint (fun ω => hpath t ω)
    rw [integral_const_mul, integral_add i2 i3, integral_add i1 (integrable_const c),
      integral_sub (hF t) (hF (t + 1)), integral_const_mul, integral_const, probReal_univ,
      one_smul] at hm
    nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (he t) hκ]
  have hsum := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun t (_ : t ∈ Finset.range T) => h1 t)
  rw [← Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_add_distrib,
    Finset.sum_range_sub' (fun t => ∫ ω, F t ω ∂Q), Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_range,
    ← Finset.mul_sum, nsmul_eq_mul] at hsum
  rw [integral_sub (hF 0) (hF T)]
  have key : (1 / (T : ℝ)) * ∑ t ∈ Finset.range T, (∫ ω, A t ω ∂Q) =
      (η * ∑ t ∈ Finset.range T, (∫ ω, A t ω ∂Q)) / (T * η) := by
    field_simp
  rw [key, div_le_iff₀ (mul_pos hTpos hη)]
  have expand : ((∫ ω, F 0 ω ∂Q) - (∫ ω, F T ω ∂Q)) / (T * η) * (T * η) +
      c / η * (T * η) + κ / η * ((1 / (T : ℝ)) * ∑ t ∈ Finset.range T, e t) * (T * η) =
      ((∫ ω, F 0 ω ∂Q) - (∫ ω, F T ω ∂Q)) + T * c + κ * ∑ t ∈ Finset.range T, e t := by
    field_simp
  rw [add_mul, add_mul, expand]
  linarith

theorem measurable_gradient_of {m n : ℕ} (f : Mat m n → ℝ) : Measurable (gradient f) := by
  have h : gradient f = fun W => (InnerProductSpace.toDual ℝ (Mat m n)).symm (fderiv ℝ f W) := rfl
  rw [h]
  exact (InnerProductSpace.toDual ℝ (Mat m n)).symm.continuous.measurable.comp (measurable_fderiv ℝ f)

theorem integrable_of_abs_le {Ξ : Type} [MeasurableSpace Ξ] (Q : Measure Ξ) [IsProbabilityMeasure Q]
    (X : Ξ → ℝ) (hX : Measurable X) (C : ℝ) (hC : ∀ ω, |X ω| ≤ C) : Integrable X Q := by
  exact Integrable.of_bound hX.aestronglyMeasurable C (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun ω => by
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]; exact hC ω))

theorem weights_recursion {m n : ℕ} (β : ℝ) (N : ℕ → Mat m n) (t : ℕ) :
    ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (t + 2), (if i = 0 then β ^ (t + 1) else (1 - β) * β ^ (t + 1 - i)) • N i =
      β • ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (t + 1), (if i = 0 then β ^ t else (1 - β) * β ^ (t - i)) • N i +
        (1 - β) • N (t + 1) := by
  rw [Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.smul_sum]
  congr 1
  · refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i hi => ?_)
    rw [Finset.mem_range] at hi
    rw [smul_smul]
    congr 1
    by_cases h0 : i = 0
    · simp only [h0, ite_true]; ring
    · simp only [h0, ite_false]
      rw [show t + 1 - i = (t - i) + 1 by omega]
      ring
  · simp

theorem spectralNorm_zero {m n : ℕ} : spectralNorm (0 : Mat m n) = 0 := by
  have h := spectralNorm_smul 0 (0 : Mat m n)
  rw [zero_smul, abs_zero, zero_mul] at h
  exact h

theorem spectralNorm_add_le {m n : ℕ} (A B : Mat m n) :
    spectralNorm (A + B) ≤ spectralNorm A + spectralNorm B := by
  unfold spectralNorm
  rw [show toMatrix (A + B) = toMatrix A + toMatrix B from rfl, map_add, map_add]
  exact norm_add_le _ _

theorem distance_from_start {m n : ℕ} (η : ℝ) (hη : 0 ≤ η) (W M : ℕ → Mat m n)
    (hW : ∀ t, W (t + 1) = W t - η • orthogonalize (M t)) (t : ℕ) :
    ‖W t - W 0‖ ≤ t * η * Real.sqrt ((min m n : ℕ) : ℝ) ∧ spectralNorm (W t - W 0) ≤ t * η := by
  induction t with
  | zero => simp only [sub_self, norm_zero, CharP.cast_eq_zero, zero_mul, le_refl, spectralNorm_zero,
      and_self]
  | succ t ih =>
    have e : W (t + 1) - W 0 = (W t - W 0) + (-η) • orthogonalize (M t) := by
      rw [hW]; module
    rw [e]
    constructor
    · refine (norm_add_le _ _).trans ?_
      rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_neg, abs_of_nonneg hη]
      have hP : ‖orthogonalize (M t)‖ ≤ Real.sqrt ((min m n : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
        rw [Real.le_sqrt (norm_nonneg _) (Nat.cast_nonneg _)]; exact norm_orthogonalize_sq_le _
      have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hP hη
      have hc : ((t + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) = t + 1 := by push_cast; ring
      rw [hc]
      nlinarith [ih.1]
    · refine (spectralNorm_add_le _ _).trans ?_
      rw [spectralNorm_smul, abs_neg, abs_of_nonneg hη]
      have := mul_le_of_le_one_right hη (spectralNorm_orthogonalize_le (M t))
      have hc : ((t + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) = t + 1 := by push_cast; ring
      rw [hc]
      nlinarith [ih.2]

theorem geom_tail_le (β : ℝ) (hβ0 : 0 ≤ β) (hβ1 : β < 1) (T : ℕ) :
    ∑ t ∈ Finset.range T, β ^ (t + 1) ≤ β / (1 - β) := by
  have h1 : ∑ t ∈ Finset.range T, β ^ (t + 1) = β * ∑ t ∈ Finset.range T, β ^ t := by
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]; exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun t _ => by ring)
  rw [h1, geom_sum_eq (ne_of_lt hβ1) T]
  have hb : 0 < 1 - β := by linarith
  have : (β ^ T - 1) / (β - 1) = (1 - β ^ T) / (1 - β) := by
    rw [← neg_sub, ← neg_sub 1 β, neg_div_neg_eq]
  rw [this, mul_div_assoc']
  apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_right _ hb.le
  nlinarith [pow_nonneg hβ0 T]

theorem noise_mean_bound {Ω : Type} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (P : ProbabilityMeasure (ℕ → Ω)) {m n : ℕ}
    (X : (ℕ → Ω) → Mat m n) (hXm : Measurable X)
    (hX2 : Integrable (fun s => ‖X s‖ ^ 2) (P : Measure (ℕ → Ω))) (σ β : ℝ) (B t : ℕ) (hσ : 0 ≤ σ)
    (hβ0 : 0 ≤ β) (hβ1 : β < 1) (hB : 1 ≤ B)
    (hle : (∫ s, ‖X s‖ ^ 2 ∂(P : Measure (ℕ → Ω))) ≤
      σ ^ 2 / B * ((1 - β) / (1 + β) + (1 - (1 - β) / (1 + β)) * β ^ (2 * t))) :
    Integrable (fun s => ‖X s‖) (P : Measure (ℕ → Ω)) ∧
      (∫ s, ‖X s‖ ∂(P : Measure (ℕ → Ω))) ≤
        σ / Real.sqrt B * (Real.sqrt ((1 - β) / (1 + β)) + β ^ (t + 1)) := by
  obtain ⟨hi, hj⟩ := integral_norm_le_sqrt (P : Measure (ℕ → Ω)) X hXm hX2
  refine ⟨hi, hj.trans ?_⟩
  have hBpos : (0 : ℝ) < B := by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < B by omega)
  have hy0 : 0 ≤ β ^ t := pow_nonneg hβ0 t
  have hy1 : β ^ t ≤ 1 := pow_le_one₀ hβ0 hβ1.le
  have hs := momentum_sqrt_le β hβ0 hβ1 (β ^ t) hy0 hy1
  rw [← pow_mul, mul_comm t 2] at hs
  refine (Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hle).trans ?_
  rw [Real.sqrt_mul (by positivity), Real.sqrt_div' _ hBpos.le, Real.sqrt_sq hσ, pow_succ, mul_comm (β ^ t) β]
  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hs (by positivity)

theorem frobenius_main {Ω : Type} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (q : Public) (L σ : ℝ) (hL : 0 ≤ L)
    (hσ : 0 ≤ σ) (hη : 0 < q.η) (hβ0 : 0 ≤ q.β) (hβ1 : q.β < 1) (hB : 1 ≤ q.B) (hT : 1 ≤ q.T)
    (f : Mat q.m q.n → ℝ) (hg : ∀ W, HasGradientAt f (gradient f W) W)
    (hlip : ∀ W W', ‖gradient f W - gradient f W'‖ ≤ L * ‖W - W'‖) (hbdd : BddBelow (Set.range f))
    (μ : ProbabilityMeasure Ω) (P : ProbabilityMeasure (ℕ → Ω)) (g : Mat q.m q.n → Ω → Mat q.m q.n)
    (hiid : LongTails.Setups.StochasticGeneralizedSmoothAndConvex.IID (fun k (s : ℕ → Ω) => s k)
      (μ : Measure Ω) (P : Measure (ℕ → Ω)))
    (ho : LongTails.Setups.StochasticSmoothAndConvex.IsStochasticGradient (Mat q.m q.n) Ω
      (μ : Measure Ω) f g σ) :
    (∀ t, Measurable (fun s => (trajectory q g s t).2.1)) ∧
    (∀ t, Integrable (fun s => nuclearNorm (gradient f (trajectory q g s t).2.1)) (P : Measure (ℕ → Ω))) ∧
    (∀ t, Integrable (fun s => f (trajectory q g s t).2.1) (P : Measure (ℕ → Ω))) ∧
    (1 / (q.T : ℝ)) * ∑ t ∈ Finset.range q.T,
        (∫ s, nuclearNorm (gradient f (trajectory q g s t).2.1) ∂(P : Measure (ℕ → Ω))) ≤
      (∫ s, f (trajectory q g s 0).2.1 - f (trajectory q g s q.T).2.1 ∂(P : Measure (ℕ → Ω))) /
          (q.T * q.η) + L * ((min q.m q.n : ℕ) : ℝ) * q.η / 2 +
        2 * σ * Real.sqrt (((min q.m q.n : ℕ) : ℝ) * (1 - q.β)) / Real.sqrt (q.B * (1 + q.β)) +
        2 * q.β * σ * Real.sqrt ((min q.m q.n : ℕ) : ℝ) / ((1 - q.β) * q.T * Real.sqrt q.B) +
        2 * ((min q.m q.n : ℕ) : ℝ) * q.η * q.β * L / (1 - q.β) := by
  set r : ℝ := ((min q.m q.n : ℕ) : ℝ) with hr
  set β := q.β
  set η := q.η
  have hr0 : 0 ≤ r := Nat.cast_nonneg _
  have hb1 : 0 < 1 - β := by linarith
  let Wt : ℕ → (ℕ → Ω) → Mat q.m q.n := fun t s => (trajectory q g s t).2.1
  let Mt : ℕ → (ℕ → Ω) → Mat q.m q.n := fun t s => (trajectory q g s (t + 1)).2.2
  let Gt : ℕ → (ℕ → Ω) → Mat q.m q.n := fun t s => batchGradient q g s t (Wt t s)
  have hW : ∀ s t, Wt (t + 1) s = Wt t s - η • orthogonalize (Mt t s) := by
    intro s t
    simp only [Wt, Mt]
    rw [trajectory_succ_eq]
  have hM0 : ∀ s, Mt 0 s = Gt 0 s := by
    intro s
    simp only [Mt, Gt, Wt]
    rw [trajectory_succ_eq]
    simp
  have hM : ∀ s t, Mt (t + 1) s = β • Mt t s + (1 - β) • Gt (t + 1) s := by
    intro s t
    simp only [Mt, Gt, Wt]
    rw [trajectory_succ_eq q g s (t + 1)]
    simp only [Nat.add_one_ne_zero, ite_false]
    rfl
  let D : ℕ → (ℕ → Ω) → Mat q.m q.n := fun t s => ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (t + 1),
    (if i = 0 then β ^ t else (1 - β) * β ^ (t - i)) • (Gt i s - gradient f (Wt i s))
  have hD0 : ∀ s, D 0 s = Gt 0 s - gradient f (Wt 0 s) := by
    intro s; simp [D]
  have hD : ∀ s t, D (t + 1) s = β • D t s + (1 - β) • (Gt (t + 1) s - gradient f (Wt (t + 1) s)) :=
    fun s t => weights_recursion β (fun i => Gt i s - gradient f (Wt i s)) t
  have hgm := measurable_gradient_of f
  have hWm : ∀ t, Measurable (Wt t) := fun t => measurable_fst.comp (trajectory_measurable q g ho.measurable t)
  have hWk : ∀ t s s', (∀ j < t * q.B, s j = s' j) → Wt t s = Wt t s' := fun t s s' h => by
    simp only [Wt]; rw [trajectory_prefix q g t s s' h]
  have hnoise := fun t => momentum_noise μ P hiid f g σ ho hgm β hβ0 hβ1 q.B hB Wt hWm hWk D
    (fun s => hD0 s) (fun t s => hD s t) t
  have hEr := fun t => noise_mean_bound P (D t) (hnoise t).1 (hnoise t).2.2.1 σ β q.B t hσ hβ0 hβ1 hB
    (hnoise t).2.2.2
  have hpath : ∀ t s, η * nuclearNorm (gradient f (Wt t s)) ≤ f (Wt t s) - f (Wt (t + 1) s) +
      (r * L * η ^ 2 / 2 + 2 * r * β * L * η ^ 2 / (1 - β)) + 2 * η * Real.sqrt r * ‖D t s‖ := by
    intro t s
    have h1 := step_frobenius f L η hη hL hg hlip (Wt t s) (Mt t s)
    rw [← hW] at h1
    have h2 := momentum_tracking_frobenius f L η β hL hη.le hβ0 hβ1 hlip (fun t => Wt t s)
      (fun t => Mt t s) (fun t => Gt t s) (fun t => D t s) (hW s) (hM0 s) (hM s) (hD0 s) (hD s) t
    have hrr : Real.sqrt r * Real.sqrt r = r := Real.mul_self_sqrt hr0
    have h3 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h2 (by positivity : 0 ≤ 2 * η * Real.sqrt r)
    have e : 2 * η * Real.sqrt r * (Real.sqrt r * β * L * η / (1 - β)) = 2 * r * β * L * η ^ 2 / (1 - β) := by
      rw [show 2 * η * Real.sqrt r * (Real.sqrt r * β * L * η / (1 - β)) =
        2 * β * L * η ^ 2 / (1 - β) * (Real.sqrt r * Real.sqrt r) by ring, hrr]
      ring
    nlinarith
  obtain ⟨lb, hlb⟩ := hbdd
  have hlb' : ∀ x, lb ≤ f x := fun x => hlb ⟨x, rfl⟩
  have hW0 : ∀ s, Wt 0 s = q.W0 := fun s => by simp only [Wt]; rw [trajectory_zero]
  have hdist : ∀ t s, ‖Wt t s - q.W0‖ ≤ t * η * Real.sqrt r := fun t s => by
    have := (distance_from_start η hη.le (fun t => Wt t s) (fun t => Mt t s) (hW s) t).1
    rwa [hW0] at this
  have hcont : Continuous f := continuous_iff_continuousAt.2 fun x => (hg x).hasFDerivAt.continuousAt
  have hAi : ∀ t, Integrable (fun s => nuclearNorm (gradient f (Wt t s))) (P : Measure (ℕ → Ω)) := by
    intro t
    refine integrable_of_abs_le _ _ (measurable_nuclearNorm.comp (hgm.comp (hWm t)))
      (Real.sqrt r * (‖gradient f q.W0‖ + L * (t * η * Real.sqrt r))) (fun s => ?_)
    rw [abs_of_nonneg (nuclearNorm_nonneg _)]
    refine (nuclearNorm_le_sqrt_mul_norm _).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ (Real.sqrt_nonneg _))
    have h1 := hlip (Wt t s) q.W0
    have h2 := norm_le_insert' (gradient f (Wt t s)) (gradient f q.W0)
    nlinarith [hdist t s, mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hdist t s) hL]
  have hFi : ∀ t, Integrable (fun s => f (Wt t s)) (P : Measure (ℕ → Ω)) := by
    intro t
    set R := t * η * Real.sqrt r
    refine integrable_of_abs_le _ _ (hcont.measurable.comp (hWm t))
      (|lb| + |f q.W0| + ‖gradient f q.W0‖ * R + L * R ^ 2 / 2) (fun s => ?_)
    have hd := frobenius_descent f L hg hlip q.W0 (Wt t s - q.W0)
    rw [add_sub_cancel] at hd
    have hi := real_inner_le_norm (gradient f q.W0) (Wt t s - q.W0)
    have hR := hdist t s
    have hn := norm_nonneg (Wt t s - q.W0)
    have hsq : ‖Wt t s - q.W0‖ ^ 2 ≤ R ^ 2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ hn hR 2
    rw [abs_le]
    constructor
    · nlinarith [hlb' (Wt t s), abs_nonneg lb, neg_abs_le lb, abs_nonneg (f q.W0),
        norm_nonneg (gradient f q.W0), mul_nonneg hL (sq_nonneg R)]
    · nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hR (norm_nonneg (gradient f q.W0)),
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsq hL, le_abs_self (f q.W0), abs_nonneg lb]
  have havg := averaged_bound (P : Measure (ℕ → Ω)) q.T hT η (r * L * η ^ 2 / 2 + 2 * r * β * L * η ^ 2 / (1 - β))
    (2 * η * Real.sqrt r) hη (by positivity) (fun t s => nuclearNorm (gradient f (Wt t s)))
    (fun t s => f (Wt t s)) (fun t s => ‖D t s‖)
    (fun t => σ / Real.sqrt q.B * (Real.sqrt ((1 - β) / (1 + β)) + β ^ (t + 1)))
    hAi hFi (fun t => (hEr t).1) hpath (fun t => (hEr t).2)
  refine ⟨hWm, hAi, hFi, havg.trans ?_⟩
  have hTpos : (0 : ℝ) < q.T := by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < q.T by omega)
  have hBpos : (0 : ℝ) < q.B := by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < q.B by omega)
  have hgeo := geom_tail_le β hβ0 hβ1 q.T
  have hsum : (1 / (q.T : ℝ)) * ∑ t ∈ Finset.range q.T,
      σ / Real.sqrt q.B * (Real.sqrt ((1 - β) / (1 + β)) + β ^ (t + 1)) ≤
      σ / Real.sqrt q.B * (Real.sqrt ((1 - β) / (1 + β)) + β / (1 - β) / q.T) := by
    rw [← Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_range, nsmul_eq_mul]
    have hc : 0 ≤ σ / Real.sqrt q.B := by positivity
    rw [show (1 / (q.T : ℝ)) * (σ / Real.sqrt q.B * (q.T * Real.sqrt ((1 - β) / (1 + β)) +
        ∑ t ∈ Finset.range q.T, β ^ (t + 1))) = σ / Real.sqrt q.B * (Real.sqrt ((1 - β) / (1 + β)) +
        (∑ t ∈ Finset.range q.T, β ^ (t + 1)) / q.T) by field_simp]
    gcongr
  have hk : 0 ≤ 2 * η * Real.sqrt r / η := by positivity
  have hstep := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsum hk
  have e1 : (r * L * η ^ 2 / 2 + 2 * r * β * L * η ^ 2 / (1 - β)) / η =
      L * r * η / 2 + 2 * r * η * β * L / (1 - β) := by field_simp
  have e2 : 2 * η * Real.sqrt r / η * (σ / Real.sqrt q.B * (Real.sqrt ((1 - β) / (1 + β)) + β / (1 - β) / q.T)) =
      2 * σ * Real.sqrt (r * (1 - β)) / Real.sqrt (q.B * (1 + β)) +
        2 * β * σ * Real.sqrt r / ((1 - β) * q.T * Real.sqrt q.B) := by
    rw [Real.sqrt_mul hr0, Real.sqrt_mul hBpos.le, Real.sqrt_div' _ (by linarith : (0:ℝ) ≤ 1 + β)]
    have : 0 < Real.sqrt (1 + β) := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (by linarith)
    have : 0 < Real.sqrt (q.B : ℝ) := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hBpos
    field_simp
  have hFT : (∫ s, f (Wt 0 s) - f (Wt q.T s) ∂(P : Measure (ℕ → Ω))) =
      ∫ s, f (trajectory q g s 0).2.1 - f (trajectory q g s q.T).2.1 ∂(P : Measure (ℕ → Ω)) := rfl
  rw [hFT, e1] at *
  linarith [e2 ▸ hstep]

theorem spectral_main {Ω : Type} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (q : Public) (L σ : ℝ) (hL : 0 ≤ L)
    (hσ : 0 ≤ σ) (hη : 0 < q.η) (hβ0 : 0 ≤ q.β) (hβ1 : q.β < 1) (hB : 1 ≤ q.B) (hT : 1 ≤ q.T)
    (f : Mat q.m q.n → ℝ) (hg : ∀ W, HasGradientAt f (gradient f W) W)
    (hlip : ∀ W W', nuclearNorm (gradient f W - gradient f W') ≤ L * spectralNorm (W - W')) (hbdd : BddBelow (Set.range f))
    (μ : ProbabilityMeasure Ω) (P : ProbabilityMeasure (ℕ → Ω)) (g : Mat q.m q.n → Ω → Mat q.m q.n)
    (hiid : LongTails.Setups.StochasticGeneralizedSmoothAndConvex.IID (fun k (s : ℕ → Ω) => s k)
      (μ : Measure Ω) (P : Measure (ℕ → Ω)))
    (ho : LongTails.Setups.StochasticSmoothAndConvex.IsStochasticGradient (Mat q.m q.n) Ω
      (μ : Measure Ω) f g σ) :
    (∀ t, Measurable (fun s => (trajectory q g s t).2.1)) ∧
    (∀ t, Integrable (fun s => nuclearNorm (gradient f (trajectory q g s t).2.1)) (P : Measure (ℕ → Ω))) ∧
    (∀ t, Integrable (fun s => f (trajectory q g s t).2.1) (P : Measure (ℕ → Ω))) ∧
    (1 / (q.T : ℝ)) * ∑ t ∈ Finset.range q.T,
        (∫ s, nuclearNorm (gradient f (trajectory q g s t).2.1) ∂(P : Measure (ℕ → Ω))) ≤
      (∫ s, f (trajectory q g s 0).2.1 - f (trajectory q g s q.T).2.1 ∂(P : Measure (ℕ → Ω))) /
          (q.T * q.η) + L * q.η / 2 +
        2 * σ * Real.sqrt (((min q.m q.n : ℕ) : ℝ) * (1 - q.β)) / Real.sqrt ((1 + q.β) * q.B) +
        2 * q.β * σ * Real.sqrt ((min q.m q.n : ℕ) : ℝ) / ((1 - q.β) * q.T * Real.sqrt q.B) +
        2 * q.η * q.β * L / (1 - q.β) := by
  set r : ℝ := ((min q.m q.n : ℕ) : ℝ) with hr
  set β := q.β
  set η := q.η
  have hr0 : 0 ≤ r := Nat.cast_nonneg _
  have hb1 : 0 < 1 - β := by linarith
  let Wt : ℕ → (ℕ → Ω) → Mat q.m q.n := fun t s => (trajectory q g s t).2.1
  let Mt : ℕ → (ℕ → Ω) → Mat q.m q.n := fun t s => (trajectory q g s (t + 1)).2.2
  let Gt : ℕ → (ℕ → Ω) → Mat q.m q.n := fun t s => batchGradient q g s t (Wt t s)
  have hW : ∀ s t, Wt (t + 1) s = Wt t s - η • orthogonalize (Mt t s) := by
    intro s t
    simp only [Wt, Mt]
    rw [trajectory_succ_eq]
  have hM0 : ∀ s, Mt 0 s = Gt 0 s := by
    intro s
    simp only [Mt, Gt, Wt]
    rw [trajectory_succ_eq]
    simp
  have hM : ∀ s t, Mt (t + 1) s = β • Mt t s + (1 - β) • Gt (t + 1) s := by
    intro s t
    simp only [Mt, Gt, Wt]
    rw [trajectory_succ_eq q g s (t + 1)]
    simp only [Nat.add_one_ne_zero, ite_false]
    rfl
  let D : ℕ → (ℕ → Ω) → Mat q.m q.n := fun t s => ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (t + 1),
    (if i = 0 then β ^ t else (1 - β) * β ^ (t - i)) • (Gt i s - gradient f (Wt i s))
  have hD0 : ∀ s, D 0 s = Gt 0 s - gradient f (Wt 0 s) := by
    intro s; simp [D]
  have hD : ∀ s t, D (t + 1) s = β • D t s + (1 - β) • (Gt (t + 1) s - gradient f (Wt (t + 1) s)) :=
    fun s t => weights_recursion β (fun i => Gt i s - gradient f (Wt i s)) t
  have hgm := measurable_gradient_of f
  have hWm : ∀ t, Measurable (Wt t) := fun t => measurable_fst.comp (trajectory_measurable q g ho.measurable t)
  have hWk : ∀ t s s', (∀ j < t * q.B, s j = s' j) → Wt t s = Wt t s' := fun t s s' h => by
    simp only [Wt]; rw [trajectory_prefix q g t s s' h]
  have hnoise := fun t => momentum_noise μ P hiid f g σ ho hgm β hβ0 hβ1 q.B hB Wt hWm hWk D
    (fun s => hD0 s) (fun t s => hD s t) t
  have hEr := fun t => noise_mean_bound P (D t) (hnoise t).1 (hnoise t).2.2.1 σ β q.B t hσ hβ0 hβ1 hB
    (hnoise t).2.2.2
  have hpath : ∀ t s, η * nuclearNorm (gradient f (Wt t s)) ≤ f (Wt t s) - f (Wt (t + 1) s) +
      (L * η ^ 2 / 2 + 2 * β * L * η ^ 2 / (1 - β)) + 2 * η * Real.sqrt r * ‖D t s‖ := by
    intro t s
    have h1 := step_spectral f L η hη hL hg hlip (Wt t s) (Mt t s)
    rw [← hW] at h1
    have h2 := momentum_tracking_spectral f L η β hL hη.le hβ0 hβ1 hlip (fun t => Wt t s)
      (fun t => Mt t s) (fun t => Gt t s) (fun t => D t s) (hW s) (hM0 s) (hM s) (hD0 s) (hD s) t
    have h3 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h2 (by positivity : 0 ≤ 2 * η)
    have e : 2 * η * (β * L * η / (1 - β)) = 2 * β * L * η ^ 2 / (1 - β) := by ring
    nlinarith
  obtain ⟨lb, hlb⟩ := hbdd
  have hlb' : ∀ x, lb ≤ f x := fun x => hlb ⟨x, rfl⟩
  have hW0 : ∀ s, Wt 0 s = q.W0 := fun s => by simp only [Wt]; rw [trajectory_zero]
  have hdist : ∀ t s, spectralNorm (Wt t s - q.W0) ≤ t * η := fun t s => by
    have := (distance_from_start η hη.le (fun t => Wt t s) (fun t => Mt t s) (hW s) t).2
    rwa [hW0] at this
  have hcont : Continuous f := continuous_iff_continuousAt.2 fun x => (hg x).hasFDerivAt.continuousAt
  have hAi : ∀ t, Integrable (fun s => nuclearNorm (gradient f (Wt t s))) (P : Measure (ℕ → Ω)) := by
    intro t
    refine integrable_of_abs_le _ _ (measurable_nuclearNorm.comp (hgm.comp (hWm t)))
      (nuclearNorm (gradient f q.W0) + L * (t * η)) (fun s => ?_)
    rw [abs_of_nonneg (nuclearNorm_nonneg _)]
    have h1 := hlip (Wt t s) q.W0
    have h2 := nuclearNorm_le_add_inner (gradient f q.W0) (gradient f (Wt t s) - gradient f q.W0)
    rw [add_sub_cancel] at h2
    nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hdist t s) hL]
  have hFi : ∀ t, Integrable (fun s => f (Wt t s)) (P : Measure (ℕ → Ω)) := by
    intro t
    set R := t * η
    have hR0 : 0 ≤ R := by positivity
    refine integrable_of_abs_le _ _ (hcont.measurable.comp (hWm t))
      (|lb| + |f q.W0| + nuclearNorm (gradient f q.W0) * R + L * R ^ 2 / 2) (fun s => ?_)
    have hd := spectral_descent f L hg hlip q.W0 (Wt t s - q.W0)
    rw [add_sub_cancel] at hd
    have hi := inner_le_nuclearNorm_mul_spectralNorm (gradient f q.W0) (Wt t s - q.W0)
    have hR := hdist t s
    have hn := spectralNorm_nonneg (Wt t s - q.W0)
    have hsq : spectralNorm (Wt t s - q.W0) ^ 2 ≤ R ^ 2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ hn hR 2
    have hnuc := nuclearNorm_nonneg (gradient f q.W0)
    rw [abs_le]
    constructor
    · nlinarith [hlb' (Wt t s), abs_nonneg lb, neg_abs_le lb, abs_nonneg (f q.W0),
        mul_nonneg hnuc hR0, mul_nonneg hL (sq_nonneg R)]
    · nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hR hnuc,
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsq hL, le_abs_self (f q.W0), abs_nonneg lb]
  have havg := averaged_bound (P : Measure (ℕ → Ω)) q.T hT η (L * η ^ 2 / 2 + 2 * β * L * η ^ 2 / (1 - β))
    (2 * η * Real.sqrt r) hη (by positivity) (fun t s => nuclearNorm (gradient f (Wt t s)))
    (fun t s => f (Wt t s)) (fun t s => ‖D t s‖)
    (fun t => σ / Real.sqrt q.B * (Real.sqrt ((1 - β) / (1 + β)) + β ^ (t + 1)))
    hAi hFi (fun t => (hEr t).1) hpath (fun t => (hEr t).2)
  refine ⟨hWm, hAi, hFi, havg.trans ?_⟩
  have hTpos : (0 : ℝ) < q.T := by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < q.T by omega)
  have hBpos : (0 : ℝ) < q.B := by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < q.B by omega)
  have hgeo := geom_tail_le β hβ0 hβ1 q.T
  have hsum : (1 / (q.T : ℝ)) * ∑ t ∈ Finset.range q.T,
      σ / Real.sqrt q.B * (Real.sqrt ((1 - β) / (1 + β)) + β ^ (t + 1)) ≤
      σ / Real.sqrt q.B * (Real.sqrt ((1 - β) / (1 + β)) + β / (1 - β) / q.T) := by
    rw [← Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_range, nsmul_eq_mul]
    have hc : 0 ≤ σ / Real.sqrt q.B := by positivity
    rw [show (1 / (q.T : ℝ)) * (σ / Real.sqrt q.B * (q.T * Real.sqrt ((1 - β) / (1 + β)) +
        ∑ t ∈ Finset.range q.T, β ^ (t + 1))) = σ / Real.sqrt q.B * (Real.sqrt ((1 - β) / (1 + β)) +
        (∑ t ∈ Finset.range q.T, β ^ (t + 1)) / q.T) by field_simp]
    gcongr
  have hk : 0 ≤ 2 * η * Real.sqrt r / η := by positivity
  have hstep := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsum hk
  have e1 : (L * η ^ 2 / 2 + 2 * β * L * η ^ 2 / (1 - β)) / η =
      L * η / 2 + 2 * η * β * L / (1 - β) := by field_simp
  have e2 : 2 * η * Real.sqrt r / η * (σ / Real.sqrt q.B * (Real.sqrt ((1 - β) / (1 + β)) + β / (1 - β) / q.T)) =
      2 * σ * Real.sqrt (r * (1 - β)) / Real.sqrt ((1 + β) * q.B) +
        2 * β * σ * Real.sqrt r / ((1 - β) * q.T * Real.sqrt q.B) := by
    rw [Real.sqrt_mul hr0, Real.sqrt_mul (by linarith : (0:ℝ) ≤ 1 + β), Real.sqrt_div' _ (by linarith : (0:ℝ) ≤ 1 + β)]
    have : 0 < Real.sqrt (1 + β) := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (by linarith)
    have : 0 < Real.sqrt (q.B : ℝ) := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hBpos
    field_simp
  have hFT : (∫ s, f (Wt 0 s) - f (Wt q.T s) ∂(P : Measure (ℕ → Ω))) =
      ∫ s, f (trajectory q g s 0).2.1 - f (trajectory q g s q.T).2.1 ∂(P : Measure (ℕ → Ω)) := rfl
  rw [hFT, e1] at *
  linarith [e2 ▸ hstep]

theorem quarter_root_eq (x Q : ℝ) (hx : 0 ≤ x) (h : x ^ 4 = Q) : Q ^ (1 / 4 : ℝ) = x := by
  rw [← h, show (1 / 4 : ℝ) = ((4 : ℕ) : ℝ)⁻¹ by norm_num]
  exact Real.pow_rpow_inv_natCast hx (by norm_num)

theorem tuned_generic (r K Δ σ β T η E : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) (hK : 0 < K) (hσ : 0 ≤ σ)
    (hβ0 : 0 ≤ β) (hβ1 : β < 1) (hT : 0 < T) (hη : 0 < η)
    (hηdef : η = Real.sqrt ((1 - β) * Δ / (T * K)))
    (hβdef : 1 - β = if σ = 0 then 1 else min (Real.sqrt (K * Δ) / (σ * Real.sqrt (r * T))) 1)
    (hE : E ≤ Δ) :
    E / (T * η) + K * η / 2 + 2 * σ * Real.sqrt (r * (1 - β)) / Real.sqrt (1 + β) +
        2 * β * σ * Real.sqrt r / ((1 - β) * T) + 2 * η * β * K / (1 - β) ≤
      6 * ((r * K * Δ * σ ^ 2 / T) ^ (1 / 4 : ℝ) + Real.sqrt (K * Δ / T) +
        r * σ ^ 2 / Real.sqrt (K * Δ * T)) := by
  have ha0 : 0 < 1 - β := by linarith
  have hΔ : 0 < Δ := by
    by_contra h
    have h' : Δ ≤ 0 := not_lt.mp h
    have : (1 - β) * Δ / (T * K) ≤ 0 :=
      div_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg (mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos ha0.le h') (by positivity)
    rw [hηdef, Real.sqrt_eq_zero'.mpr this] at hη
    exact lt_irrefl _ hη
  have hsa : 0 < Real.sqrt (1 - β) := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr ha0
  have hsD : 0 < Real.sqrt Δ := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hΔ
  have hsT : 0 < Real.sqrt T := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hT
  have hsK : 0 < Real.sqrt K := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hK
  have hsr : 0 < Real.sqrt r := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hr
  have qa : Real.sqrt (1 - β) ^ 2 = 1 - β := Real.sq_sqrt ha0.le
  have qD : Real.sqrt Δ ^ 2 = Δ := Real.sq_sqrt hΔ.le
  have qT : Real.sqrt T ^ 2 = T := Real.sq_sqrt hT.le
  have qK : Real.sqrt K ^ 2 = K := Real.sq_sqrt hK.le
  have qr : Real.sqrt r ^ 2 = r := Real.sq_sqrt hr.le
  have sa1 : Real.sqrt (1 - β) ≤ 1 := by rw [Real.sqrt_le_one]; linarith
  have eη : η = Real.sqrt (1 - β) * Real.sqrt Δ / (Real.sqrt T * Real.sqrt K) := by
    rw [hηdef, Real.sqrt_div (by positivity), Real.sqrt_mul ha0.le, Real.sqrt_mul hT.le]
  have eY : Real.sqrt (K * Δ / T) = Real.sqrt K * Real.sqrt Δ / Real.sqrt T := by
    rw [Real.sqrt_div (by positivity), Real.sqrt_mul hK.le]
  set sa := Real.sqrt (1 - β)
  set sD := Real.sqrt Δ
  set sT := Real.sqrt T
  set sK := Real.sqrt K
  set sr := Real.sqrt r
  set Y := Real.sqrt (K * Δ / T)
  have hY0 : 0 ≤ Y := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  have hX0 : 0 ≤ (r * K * Δ * σ ^ 2 / T) ^ (1 / 4 : ℝ) := by positivity
  have hZ0 : 0 ≤ r * σ ^ 2 / Real.sqrt (K * Δ * T) := by positivity
  have t1 : E / (T * η) ≤ Y / sa := by
    rw [eη, eY, div_le_div_iff₀ (by positivity) hsa]
    have h2 : E * sa ≤ sD ^ 2 * sa := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (qD ▸ hE) hsa.le
    have e : sK * sD / sT * (T * (sa * sD / (sT * sK))) = sD ^ 2 * sa := by
      rw [← qT]; field_simp
    linarith
  have t2 : K * η / 2 ≤ Y / 2 := by
    rw [eη, eY]
    have e : K * (sa * sD / (sT * sK)) = sa * (sK * sD / sT) := by rw [← qK]; field_simp
    rw [e]
    have hy : 0 ≤ sK * sD / sT := by positivity
    nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right sa1 hy]
  have t5 : 2 * η * β * K / (1 - β) ≤ 2 * Y / sa := by
    rw [eη, eY, div_le_div_iff₀ ha0 hsa]
    have e : 2 * (sa * sD / (sT * sK)) * β * K * sa = (1 - β) * (2 * (sK * sD / sT)) * β := by
      rw [← qK, ← qa]; field_simp
    rw [e]
    have hy : 0 ≤ (1 - β) * (2 * (sK * sD / sT)) := by positivity
    nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (show β ≤ 1 by linarith) hy]
  have t3 : 2 * σ * Real.sqrt (r * (1 - β)) / Real.sqrt (1 + β) ≤ 2 * σ * sr * sa := by
    rw [Real.sqrt_mul hr.le]
    have h1 : 1 ≤ Real.sqrt (1 + β) := by rw [Real.le_sqrt (by norm_num) (by linarith)]; linarith
    rw [div_le_iff₀ (by linarith)]
    have : 0 ≤ 2 * σ * (sr * sa) := by positivity
    nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 this]
  by_cases hσ0 : σ = 0
  · rw [ite_eq_left hσ0] at hβdef
    have hβz : β = 0 := by linarith
    have hsa1 : sa = 1 := by
      show Real.sqrt (1 - β) = 1
      rw [hβz, sub_zero, Real.sqrt_one]
    rw [hsa1, div_one] at t1
    have z4 : 2 * β * σ * Real.sqrt r / ((1 - β) * T) = 0 := by rw [hσ0]; ring
    have z5 : 2 * η * β * K / (1 - β) = 0 := by rw [hβz]; ring
    have z3 : 2 * σ * Real.sqrt (r * (1 - β)) / Real.sqrt (1 + β) = 0 := by rw [hσ0]; ring
    rw [z4, z5, z3]
    linarith
  · have hσp : 0 < σ := lt_of_le_of_ne hσ (Ne.symm hσ0)
    rw [ite_eq_right hσ0] at hβdef
    have ec : Real.sqrt (K * Δ) / (σ * Real.sqrt (r * T)) = sK * sD / (σ * sr * sT) := by
      rw [Real.sqrt_mul hK.le, Real.sqrt_mul hr.le]; ring
    rw [ec] at hβdef
    rcases le_total 1 (sK * sD / (σ * sr * sT)) with hc | hc
    · rw [min_eq_right hc] at hβdef
      have hβz : β = 0 := by linarith
      have hsa1 : sa = 1 := by
        show Real.sqrt (1 - β) = 1
        rw [hβz, sub_zero, Real.sqrt_one]
      rw [hsa1, div_one] at t1
      rw [hsa1, mul_one] at t3
      have hσY : σ * sr ≤ Y := by
        rw [eY, le_div_iff₀ hsT]
        rw [le_div_iff₀ (by positivity)] at hc
        linarith
      have z4 : 2 * β * σ * Real.sqrt r / ((1 - β) * T) = 0 := by rw [hβz]; ring
      have z5 : 2 * η * β * K / (1 - β) = 0 := by rw [hβz]; ring
      rw [z4, z5]
      nlinarith
    · rw [min_eq_left hc] at hβdef
      have hsa2 : sa ^ 2 = sK * sD / (σ * sr * sT) := by rw [qa, hβdef]
      have hYsa : Y / sa = σ * sr * sa := by
        rw [div_eq_iff hsa.ne', eY]
        have : σ * sr * sa * sa = σ * sr * sa ^ 2 := by ring
        rw [this, hsa2]
        field_simp
      have hX : (r * K * Δ * σ ^ 2 / T) ^ (1 / 4 : ℝ) = σ * sr * sa := by
        apply quarter_root_eq _ _ (by positivity)
        rw [mul_pow, mul_pow, show sa ^ 4 = (sa ^ 2) ^ 2 by ring, hsa2, ← qr, ← qK, ← qD, ← qT]
        field_simp
      have hZ : 2 * β * σ * sr / ((1 - β) * T) ≤ 2 * (r * σ ^ 2 / Real.sqrt (K * Δ * T)) := by
        rw [Real.sqrt_mul (by positivity), Real.sqrt_mul hK.le, hβdef]
        rw [div_le_iff₀ (by positivity)]
        have e : 2 * (r * σ ^ 2 / (sK * sD * sT)) * (sK * sD / (σ * sr * sT) * T) = 2 * σ * sr := by
          rw [← qr, ← qT]; field_simp
        rw [e]
        have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (show β ≤ 1 by linarith) (by positivity : (0:ℝ) ≤ 2 * σ * sr)
        calc 2 * β * σ * sr = β * (2 * σ * sr) := by ring
          _ ≤ 1 * (2 * σ * sr) := hm
          _ = 2 * σ * sr := one_mul _
      have e2 : 2 * Y / sa = 2 * (Y / sa) := by ring
      linarith [hX, hZ, t1, t2, t3, t5, hY0, hZ0, hYsa, e2]

theorem complexity_generic (r K Δ σ T ε : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) (hK : 0 < K) (hΔ : 0 < Δ) (hT : 0 < T)
    (hε : 0 < ε)
    (hTbig : 18 ^ 4 * r * K * Δ * σ ^ 2 / ε ^ 4 + 18 ^ 2 * K * Δ / ε ^ 2 +
      18 ^ 2 * r ^ 2 * σ ^ 4 / (K * Δ * ε ^ 2) ≤ T) :
    6 * ((r * K * Δ * σ ^ 2 / T) ^ (1 / 4 : ℝ) + Real.sqrt (K * Δ / T) +
      r * σ ^ 2 / Real.sqrt (K * Δ * T)) ≤ ε := by
  have a1 : 0 ≤ 18 ^ 4 * r * K * Δ * σ ^ 2 / ε ^ 4 := by positivity
  have a2 : 0 ≤ 18 ^ 2 * K * Δ / ε ^ 2 := by positivity
  have a3 : 0 ≤ 18 ^ 2 * r ^ 2 * σ ^ 4 / (K * Δ * ε ^ 2) := by positivity
  have hX : (r * K * Δ * σ ^ 2 / T) ^ (1 / 4 : ℝ) ≤ ε / 18 := by
    have hQ : r * K * Δ * σ ^ 2 / T ≤ (ε / 18) ^ 4 := by
      have h1 : 18 ^ 4 * r * K * Δ * σ ^ 2 / ε ^ 4 ≤ T := by linarith
      rw [div_le_iff₀ (by positivity)] at h1
      rw [div_le_iff₀ hT]
      have : (ε / 18) ^ 4 * T = ε ^ 4 * T / 18 ^ 4 := by ring
      rw [this, le_div_iff₀ (by norm_num)]
      nlinarith
    calc (r * K * Δ * σ ^ 2 / T) ^ (1 / 4 : ℝ) ≤ ((ε / 18) ^ 4) ^ (1 / 4 : ℝ) :=
          Real.rpow_le_rpow (by positivity) hQ (by norm_num)
      _ = ε / 18 := quarter_root_eq _ _ (by positivity) rfl
  have hY : Real.sqrt (K * Δ / T) ≤ ε / 18 := by
    rw [Real.sqrt_le_left (by positivity)]
    have h1 : 18 ^ 2 * K * Δ / ε ^ 2 ≤ T := by linarith
    rw [div_le_iff₀ (by positivity)] at h1
    rw [div_le_iff₀ hT]
    have : (ε / 18) ^ 2 * T = ε ^ 2 * T / 18 ^ 2 := by ring
    rw [this, le_div_iff₀ (by norm_num)]
    nlinarith
  have hZ : r * σ ^ 2 / Real.sqrt (K * Δ * T) ≤ ε / 18 := by
    have hs : 0 < Real.sqrt (K * Δ * T) := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (by positivity)
    rw [div_le_iff₀ hs]
    have h1 : 18 ^ 2 * r ^ 2 * σ ^ 4 / (K * Δ * ε ^ 2) ≤ T := by linarith
    rw [div_le_iff₀ (by positivity)] at h1
    have hsq : (r * σ ^ 2) ^ 2 ≤ (ε / 18 * Real.sqrt (K * Δ * T)) ^ 2 := by
      rw [mul_pow (ε / 18), Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)]
      nlinarith
    exact (pow_le_pow_iff_left₀ (by positivity) (by positivity) two_ne_zero).mp hsq
  linarith

theorem momentum_error {Ω : Type} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (q : Public) (σ : ℝ) (hσ : 0 ≤ σ)
    (hβ0 : 0 ≤ q.β) (hβ1 : q.β < 1) (hB : 1 ≤ q.B) (f : Mat q.m q.n → ℝ)
    (μ : ProbabilityMeasure Ω) (P : ProbabilityMeasure (ℕ → Ω)) (g : Mat q.m q.n → Ω → Mat q.m q.n)
    (hiid : LongTails.Setups.StochasticGeneralizedSmoothAndConvex.IID (fun k (s : ℕ → Ω) => s k)
      (μ : Measure Ω) (P : Measure (ℕ → Ω)))
    (ho : LongTails.Setups.StochasticSmoothAndConvex.IsStochasticGradient (Mat q.m q.n) Ω
      (μ : Measure Ω) f g σ)
    (C : ℕ → (ℕ → Ω) → Mat q.m q.n) (hC0 : ∀ s, C 0 s = gradient f (trajectory q g s 0).2.1)
    (hC : ∀ t s, C (t + 1) s = q.β • C t s + (1 - q.β) • gradient f (trajectory q g s (t + 1)).2.1)
    (t : ℕ) :
    Integrable (fun s => ‖C t s - (trajectory q g s (t + 1)).2.2‖) (P : Measure (ℕ → Ω)) ∧
      (∫ s, ‖C t s - (trajectory q g s (t + 1)).2.2‖ ∂(P : Measure (ℕ → Ω))) ≤
        Real.sqrt ((1 - q.β) / (1 + q.β)) * σ / Real.sqrt q.B + q.β ^ t * σ / Real.sqrt q.B := by
  set β := q.β
  let Wt : ℕ → (ℕ → Ω) → Mat q.m q.n := fun t s => (trajectory q g s t).2.1
  let Mt : ℕ → (ℕ → Ω) → Mat q.m q.n := fun t s => (trajectory q g s (t + 1)).2.2
  let Gt : ℕ → (ℕ → Ω) → Mat q.m q.n := fun t s => batchGradient q g s t (Wt t s)
  have hM0 : ∀ s, Mt 0 s = Gt 0 s := by
    intro s
    simp only [Mt, Gt, Wt]
    rw [trajectory_succ_eq]
    simp
  have hM : ∀ s t, Mt (t + 1) s = β • Mt t s + (1 - β) • Gt (t + 1) s := by
    intro s t
    simp only [Mt, Gt, Wt]
    rw [trajectory_succ_eq q g s (t + 1)]
    simp only [Nat.add_one_ne_zero, ite_false]
    rfl
  let D : ℕ → (ℕ → Ω) → Mat q.m q.n := fun t s => ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (t + 1),
    (if i = 0 then β ^ t else (1 - β) * β ^ (t - i)) • (Gt i s - gradient f (Wt i s))
  have hD0 : ∀ s, D 0 s = Gt 0 s - gradient f (Wt 0 s) := by
    intro s; simp [D]
  have hD : ∀ s t, D (t + 1) s = β • D t s + (1 - β) • (Gt (t + 1) s - gradient f (Wt (t + 1) s)) :=
    fun s t => weights_recursion β (fun i => Gt i s - gradient f (Wt i s)) t
  have hCM : ∀ t s, C t s - Mt t s = -D t s := by
    intro t
    induction t with
    | zero => intro s; rw [hC0, hM0, hD0]; simp only [Wt]; module
    | succ t ih =>
      intro s
      have e : C t s = Mt t s - D t s := by rw [← sub_eq_zero]; have := ih s; rw [← sub_eq_zero] at this; rw [← this]; module
      rw [hC, hM, hD, e]
      simp only [Wt]
      module
  have hWm : ∀ t, Measurable (Wt t) := fun t => measurable_fst.comp (trajectory_measurable q g ho.measurable t)
  have hWk : ∀ t s s', (∀ j < t * q.B, s j = s' j) → Wt t s = Wt t s' := fun t s s' h => by
    simp only [Wt]; rw [trajectory_prefix q g t s s' h]
  have hnoise := momentum_noise μ P hiid f g σ ho (measurable_gradient_of f) β hβ0 hβ1 q.B hB Wt hWm hWk D
    (fun s => hD0 s) (fun t s => hD s t) t
  have hEr := noise_mean_bound P (D t) hnoise.1 hnoise.2.2.1 σ β q.B t hσ hβ0 hβ1 hB hnoise.2.2.2
  have hnorm : (fun s => ‖C t s - (trajectory q g s (t + 1)).2.2‖) = fun s => ‖D t s‖ := by
    funext s
    rw [show (trajectory q g s (t + 1)).2.2 = Mt t s from rfl, hCM t s, norm_neg]
  rw [hnorm]
  refine ⟨hEr.1, hEr.2.trans ?_⟩
  have hBpos : 0 < Real.sqrt q.B := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < q.B by omega))
  have hpow : β ^ (t + 1) ≤ β ^ t := pow_le_pow_of_le_one hβ0 hβ1.le (Nat.le_succ t)
  rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, mul_add, add_div]
  have h1 : σ * Real.sqrt ((1 - β) / (1 + β)) / Real.sqrt q.B =
      Real.sqrt ((1 - β) / (1 + β)) * σ / Real.sqrt q.B := by ring
  have h2 : σ * β ^ (t + 1) / Real.sqrt q.B ≤ β ^ t * σ / Real.sqrt q.B := by
    rw [mul_comm σ]
    exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hpow hσ) hBpos.le
  linarith

end OracleTemplate.Muon

import outputs.Algorithms.MuonTuning

open MeasureTheory

namespace outputs.Proofs.MuonSelection

open OracleTemplate OracleTemplate.Muon

open outputs.Algorithms.MuonTuning

theorem execute_random {Ω : Type} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (q : OracleTemplate.Muon.Public)
    (N : ℕ) (hT : q.T = N + 1) (hB : 1 ≤ q.B)
    (P : ProbabilityMeasure (ℕ → Ω)) (g : Mat q.m q.n → Ω → Mat q.m q.n)
    (j : Fin (N + 1)) (tape : ℕ → Ω) :
    execute (sampleOracle P g) (randomMuon q N) (fun _ => q.T * q.B) j tape =
      (trajectory q g tape j.val).2.1 := by sorry

theorem uniform_selection {Ω : Type} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {m n : ℕ} (N : ℕ)
    (P : ProbabilityMeasure Ω) (f : Mat m n → ℝ) (W : Fin (N + 1) → Ω → Mat m n)
    (hW : ∀ j, Measurable (W j))
    (hI : ∀ j, Integrable (fun ω => nuclearNorm (gradient f (W j ω))) (P : Measure Ω)) :
    Measurable (fun z : Fin (N + 1) × Ω => W z.1 z.2) ∧
    Integrable (fun z : Fin (N + 1) × Ω => nuclearNorm (gradient f (W z.1 z.2)))
      ((PMF.uniformOfFintype (Fin (N + 1))).toMeasure.prod (P : Measure Ω)) ∧
    (∫ z : Fin (N + 1) × Ω, nuclearNorm (gradient f (W z.1 z.2))
      ∂((PMF.uniformOfFintype (Fin (N + 1))).toMeasure.prod (P : Measure Ω))) =
      (1 / ((N + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) * ∑ j : Fin (N + 1),
        ∫ ω, nuclearNorm (gradient f (W j ω)) ∂(P : Measure Ω) := by sorry

end outputs.Proofs.MuonSelection

import LongTails.Algorithms.Muon
import LongTails.Setups.StochasticSmoothAndConvex
import LongTails.Setups.StochasticGeneralizedSmoothAndConvex
import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Pow.Real

open MeasureTheory

namespace LongTails.Setups.MuonFrobenius

open OracleTemplate OracleTemplate.Muon

structure Params where
  m : ℕ
  n : ℕ
  L : ℝ
  σ : ℝ
  η : ℝ
  β : ℝ
  B : ℕ
  T : ℕ
  W0 : Mat m n

def publicInput (p : Params) : Muon.Public := ⟨p.m, p.n, p.η, p.β, p.B, p.T, p.W0⟩

def FrobeniusSmooth {m n : ℕ} (L : ℝ) (f : Mat m n → ℝ) : Prop :=
  (∀ W, HasGradientAt f (gradient f W) W) ∧ ∀ W W', ‖gradient f W - gradient f W'‖ ≤ L * ‖W - W'‖

def StochasticOracleModel {m n : ℕ} (f : Mat m n → ℝ) (σ : ℝ) (O : Oracle (Mat m n) (Mat m n)) : Prop :=
  ∃ (Ω : Type) (mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω),
    letI := mΩ
    ∃ (μ : ProbabilityMeasure Ω) (P : ProbabilityMeasure (ℕ → Ω)) (g : Mat m n → Ω → Mat m n),
      LongTails.Setups.StochasticGeneralizedSmoothAndConvex.IID (fun k (s : ℕ → Ω) => s k)
        (μ : Measure Ω) (P : Measure (ℕ → Ω)) ∧
      LongTails.Setups.StochasticSmoothAndConvex.IsStochasticGradient (Mat m n) Ω (μ : Measure Ω) f g σ ∧
      O = sampleOracle P g

noncomputable def averageNuclear (p : Params) (f : Mat p.m p.n → ℝ) {Ω : Type} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    (W : Ω → Fin (p.T + 1) → Mat p.m p.n) (P : Measure Ω) : ℝ :=
  (1 / (p.T : ℝ)) * ∑ t : Fin p.T, ∫ ω, nuclearNorm (gradient f (W ω t.castSucc)) ∂P

def Guarantee (p : Params) (f : Mat p.m p.n → ℝ) {Ω : Type} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    (W : Ω → Fin (p.T + 1) → Mat p.m p.n) (P : Measure Ω) : Prop :=
  let r : ℝ := (min p.m p.n : ℕ)
  let T : ℝ := p.T
  let Δ : ℝ := f p.W0 - ⨅ W, f W
  let avg := averageNuclear p f W P
  (∀ t, Measurable (fun ω => W ω t)) ∧
  (∀ t, Integrable (fun ω => nuclearNorm (gradient f (W ω t))) P) ∧
  (∀ t, Integrable (fun ω => f (W ω t)) P) ∧
  avg ≤ (∫ ω, f (W ω 0) - f (W ω (Fin.last p.T)) ∂P) / (T * p.η) + p.L * r * p.η / 2 +
      2 * p.σ * Real.sqrt (r * (1 - p.β)) / Real.sqrt (p.B * (1 + p.β)) +
      2 * p.β * p.σ * Real.sqrt r / ((1 - p.β) * T * Real.sqrt p.B) +
      2 * r * p.η * p.β * p.L / (1 - p.β) ∧
  (0 < p.L → p.B = 1 → p.η = Real.sqrt ((1 - p.β) * Δ / (r * T * p.L)) →
    1 - p.β = (if p.σ = 0 then 1 else min (Real.sqrt (p.L * Δ) / (p.σ * Real.sqrt T)) 1) →
    avg ≤ 6 * ((r ^ 2 * p.L * Δ * p.σ ^ 2 / T) ^ (1 / 4 : ℝ) + Real.sqrt (r * p.L * Δ / T) +
      Real.sqrt r * p.σ ^ 2 / Real.sqrt (p.L * Δ * T)) ∧
    ∀ ε > 0, 18 ^ 4 * r ^ 2 * p.L * Δ * p.σ ^ 2 / ε ^ 4 + 18 ^ 2 * r * p.L * Δ / ε ^ 2 +
        18 ^ 2 * r * p.σ ^ 4 / (p.L * Δ * ε ^ 2) ≤ T →
      avg ≤ ε ∧ ∃ t : Fin p.T, ∫ ω, nuclearNorm (gradient f (W ω t.castSucc)) ∂P ≤ ε)

noncomputable abbrev spec : Setup where
  Params := Params
  Public := Muon.Public
  Instance p := Mat p.m p.n → ℝ
  Query p := Mat p.m p.n
  Reply p := Mat p.m p.n
  Output p := Fin (p.T + 1) → Mat p.m p.n
  publicInput := publicInput
  valid p := 0 < p.m ∧ 0 < p.n ∧ 0 ≤ p.L ∧ 0 ≤ p.σ ∧ 0 < p.η ∧ 0 ≤ p.β ∧ p.β < 1 ∧
    1 ≤ p.B ∧ 1 ≤ p.T
  admissible p f O := FrobeniusSmooth p.L f ∧ BddBelow (Set.range f) ∧ StochasticOracleModel f p.σ O
  successful p f W P := Guarantee p f W (P : Measure _)
  allowedAlgorithm q A := A = muon q

attribute [local simp] publicInput FrobeniusSmooth StochasticOracleModel averageNuclear Guarantee

end LongTails.Setups.MuonFrobenius

import LongTails.Algorithms.Muon
import LongTails.Setups.MuonFrobenius
import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Pow.Real

open MeasureTheory

namespace LongTails.Setups.MuonSpectral

open OracleTemplate OracleTemplate.Muon

structure Params where
  m : ℕ
  n : ℕ
  Ls : ℝ
  σ : ℝ
  η : ℝ
  β : ℝ
  B : ℕ
  T : ℕ
  W0 : Mat m n

def publicInput (p : Params) : Muon.Public := ⟨p.m, p.n, p.η, p.β, p.B, p.T, p.W0⟩

def SpectralSmooth {m n : ℕ} (Ls : ℝ) (f : Mat m n → ℝ) : Prop :=
  (∀ W, HasGradientAt f (gradient f W) W) ∧
    ∀ W W', nuclearNorm (gradient f W - gradient f W') ≤ Ls * spectralNorm (W - W')

noncomputable def averageNuclear (p : Params) (f : Mat p.m p.n → ℝ) {Ω : Type} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    (W : Ω → Fin (p.T + 1) → Mat p.m p.n) (P : Measure Ω) : ℝ :=
  (1 / (p.T : ℝ)) * ∑ t : Fin p.T, ∫ ω, nuclearNorm (gradient f (W ω t.castSucc)) ∂P

def Guarantee (p : Params) (f : Mat p.m p.n → ℝ) {Ω : Type} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    (W : Ω → Fin (p.T + 1) → Mat p.m p.n) (P : Measure Ω) : Prop :=
  let r : ℝ := (min p.m p.n : ℕ)
  let T : ℝ := p.T
  let Δ : ℝ := f p.W0 - ⨅ W, f W
  let avg := averageNuclear p f W P
  (∀ t, Measurable (fun ω => W ω t)) ∧
  (∀ t, Integrable (fun ω => nuclearNorm (gradient f (W ω t))) P) ∧
  (∀ t, Integrable (fun ω => f (W ω t)) P) ∧
  avg ≤ (∫ ω, f (W ω 0) - f (W ω (Fin.last p.T)) ∂P) / (T * p.η) + p.Ls * p.η / 2 +
      2 * p.σ * Real.sqrt (r * (1 - p.β)) / Real.sqrt ((1 + p.β) * p.B) +
      2 * p.β * p.σ * Real.sqrt r / ((1 - p.β) * T * Real.sqrt p.B) +
      2 * p.η * p.β * p.Ls / (1 - p.β) ∧
  (0 < p.Ls → p.B = 1 → p.η = Real.sqrt ((1 - p.β) * Δ / (T * p.Ls)) →
    1 - p.β = (if p.σ = 0 then 1 else min (Real.sqrt (p.Ls * Δ) / (p.σ * Real.sqrt (r * T))) 1) →
    avg ≤ 6 * ((r * p.Ls * Δ * p.σ ^ 2 / T) ^ (1 / 4 : ℝ) + Real.sqrt (p.Ls * Δ / T) +
      r * p.σ ^ 2 / Real.sqrt (p.Ls * Δ * T)) ∧
    ∀ ε > 0, 18 ^ 4 * r * p.Ls * Δ * p.σ ^ 2 / ε ^ 4 + 18 ^ 2 * p.Ls * Δ / ε ^ 2 +
        18 ^ 2 * r ^ 2 * p.σ ^ 4 / (p.Ls * Δ * ε ^ 2) ≤ T →
      avg ≤ ε ∧ ∃ t : Fin p.T, ∫ ω, nuclearNorm (gradient f (W ω t.castSucc)) ∂P ≤ ε)

noncomputable abbrev spec : Setup where
  Params := Params
  Public := Muon.Public
  Instance p := Mat p.m p.n → ℝ
  Query p := Mat p.m p.n
  Reply p := Mat p.m p.n
  Output p := Fin (p.T + 1) → Mat p.m p.n
  publicInput := publicInput
  valid p := 0 < p.m ∧ 0 < p.n ∧ 0 ≤ p.Ls ∧ 0 ≤ p.σ ∧ 0 < p.η ∧ 0 ≤ p.β ∧ p.β < 1 ∧
    1 ≤ p.B ∧ 1 ≤ p.T
  admissible p f O := SpectralSmooth p.Ls f ∧ BddBelow (Set.range f) ∧
    LongTails.Setups.MuonFrobenius.StochasticOracleModel f p.σ O
  successful p f W P := Guarantee p f W (P : Measure _)
  allowedAlgorithm q A := A = muon q

attribute [local simp] publicInput SpectralSmooth averageNuclear Guarantee

end LongTails.Setups.MuonSpectral

import LongTails.Algorithms.SimplifiedMuon
import Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.Gradient.Basic

open MeasureTheory

namespace LongTails.Setups.MuonThirdOrder

open OracleTemplate OracleTemplate.Muon

structure Params where
  m : ℕ
  n : ℕ
  s : ℝ
  η : ℝ
  T : ℕ
  W0 : Mat m n

def publicInput (p : Params) : SimplifiedMuon.Public := ⟨p.m, p.n, p.η, p.T, p.W0⟩

def ThirdDerivativeBounded {m n : ℕ} (s : ℝ) (f : Mat m n → ℝ) : Prop :=
  Differentiable ℝ f ∧ Differentiable ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) ∧ Differentiable ℝ (iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 f) ∧
    ∀ W U V X, |iteratedFDeriv ℝ 3 f W ![U, V, X]| ≤ s * ‖U‖ * ‖V‖ * ‖X‖

noncomputable def hessianQuadratic {m n : ℕ} (f : Mat m n → ℝ) (W : Mat m n) : ℝ :=
  iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 f W ![orthogonalize (gradient f W), orthogonalize (gradient f W)]

def Guarantee (p : Params) (f : Mat p.m p.n → ℝ) (W : Fin (p.T + 1) → Mat p.m p.n) : Prop :=
  let r : ℝ := (min p.m p.n : ℕ)
  let T : ℝ := p.T
  let Δ : ℝ := f p.W0 - ⨅ W, f W
  let avg := (1 / T) * ∑ t : Fin p.T, nuclearNorm (gradient f (W t.castSucc))
  let J := (1 / T) * ∑ t : Fin p.T, hessianQuadratic f (W t.castSucc)
  avg ≤ (f (W 0) - f (W (Fin.last p.T))) / (T * p.η) + p.η * J / 2 +
      p.s * p.η ^ 2 * (r * Real.sqrt r) / 6 ∧
  (0 < J → p.η = Real.sqrt (2 * Δ / (J * T)) →
    avg ≤ Real.sqrt (2 * J * Δ / T) + p.s * (r * Real.sqrt r) * Δ / (3 * J * T) ∧
    ∀ ε > 0, 8 * J * Δ / ε ^ 2 ≤ T → 2 * p.s * (r * Real.sqrt r) * Δ / (3 * J * ε) ≤ T →
      avg ≤ ε ∧ ∃ t : Fin p.T, NuclearStationary f (W t.castSucc) ε)

noncomputable abbrev spec : Setup where
  Params := Params
  Public := SimplifiedMuon.Public
  Instance p := Mat p.m p.n → ℝ
  Query p := Mat p.m p.n
  Reply p := Mat p.m p.n
  Output p := Fin (p.T + 1) → Mat p.m p.n
  publicInput := publicInput
  valid p := 0 < p.m ∧ 0 < p.n ∧ 0 ≤ p.s ∧ 0 < p.η ∧ 1 ≤ p.T
  admissible p f O :=
    ThirdDerivativeBounded p.s f ∧ BddBelow (Set.range f) ∧
      ∀ k W seed, O.answer k (0, W) seed = gradient f W
  successful p f W _ := ∀ ω, Guarantee p f (W ω)
  allowedAlgorithm q A := A = SimplifiedMuon.simplifiedMuon q

attribute [local simp] publicInput ThirdDerivativeBounded hessianQuadratic Guarantee

end LongTails.Setups.MuonThirdOrder

import LongTails.Proofs.MuonDescent
import LongTails.Proofs.RingmasterStochastic
import LongTails.Setups.StochasticSmoothAndConvex

open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory
open scoped RealInnerProductSpace

namespace OracleTemplate.Muon

variable {m n : ℕ} {Ω : Type} [MeasurableSpace Ω]

theorem noise_sq (μ : ProbabilityMeasure Ω) (P : ProbabilityMeasure (ℕ → Ω))
    (hiid : LongTails.Setups.StochasticGeneralizedSmoothAndConvex.IID (fun k (s : ℕ → Ω) => s k)
      (μ : Measure Ω) (P : Measure (ℕ → Ω)))
    (f : Mat m n → ℝ) (g : Mat m n → Ω → Mat m n) (σ : ℝ)
    (ho : LongTails.Setups.StochasticSmoothAndConvex.IsStochasticGradient (Mat m n) Ω (μ : Measure Ω) f g σ)
    (hgm : Measurable (gradient f)) (k : ℕ) (Y : (ℕ → Ω) → Mat m n) (hYm : Measurable Y)
    (hYk : ∀ s s', (∀ j < k, s j = s' j) → Y s = Y s') :
    Integrable (fun s => ‖g (Y s) (s k) - gradient f (Y s)‖ ^ 2) (P : Measure (ℕ → Ω)) ∧
      (∫ s, ‖g (Y s) (s k) - gradient f (Y s)‖ ^ 2 ∂(P : Measure (ℕ → Ω))) ≤ σ ^ 2 := by
  let Φ : (ℕ → Ω) → Ω → ℝ := fun s b => ‖g (Y s) b - gradient f (Y s)‖ ^ 2
  have hΦ : Measurable (Function.uncurry Φ) :=
    ((ho.measurable.comp ((hYm.comp measurable_fst).prodMk measurable_snd)).sub
      (hgm.comp (hYm.comp measurable_fst))).norm.pow_const 2
  have h := RingmasterAsgd.step_bound μ P (fun k (s : ℕ → Ω) => s k) hiid k Φ hΦ
    (fun s s' b h => by simp only [Φ]; rw [hYk s s' h]) (fun _ _ => sq_nonneg _)
    (fun s => ho.variance_integrable (Y s)) (fun _ => σ ^ 2) (integrable_const _)
    (fun s => ho.variance (Y s))
  simp only [integral_const, probReal_univ, smul_eq_mul, one_mul] at h
  exact h

theorem noise_cross (μ : ProbabilityMeasure Ω) (P : ProbabilityMeasure (ℕ → Ω))
    (hiid : LongTails.Setups.StochasticGeneralizedSmoothAndConvex.IID (fun k (s : ℕ → Ω) => s k)
      (μ : Measure Ω) (P : Measure (ℕ → Ω)))
    (f : Mat m n → ℝ) (g : Mat m n → Ω → Mat m n) (σ : ℝ)
    (ho : LongTails.Setups.StochasticSmoothAndConvex.IsStochasticGradient (Mat m n) Ω (μ : Measure Ω) f g σ)
    (hgm : Measurable (gradient f)) (k : ℕ) (X Y : (ℕ → Ω) → Mat m n) (hXm : Measurable X)
    (hYm : Measurable Y) (hXk : ∀ s s', (∀ j < k, s j = s' j) → X s = X s')
    (hYk : ∀ s s', (∀ j < k, s j = s' j) → Y s = Y s')
    (hX2 : Integrable (fun s => ‖X s‖ ^ 2) (P : Measure (ℕ → Ω))) :
    Integrable (fun s => ⟪X s, g (Y s) (s k) - gradient f (Y s)⟫) (P : Measure (ℕ → Ω)) ∧
      (∫ s, ⟪X s, g (Y s) (s k) - gradient f (Y s)⟫ ∂(P : Measure (ℕ → Ω))) = 0 := by
  let Φ : (ℕ → Ω) → Ω → ℝ := fun s b => (inner ℝ (X s) (g (Y s) b - gradient f (Y s)))
  have hnm : Measurable (fun z : (ℕ → Ω) × Ω => g (Y z.1) z.2 - gradient f (Y z.1)) :=
    (ho.measurable.comp ((hYm.comp measurable_fst).prodMk measurable_snd)).sub
      (hgm.comp (hYm.comp measurable_fst))
  have hΦ : Measurable (Function.uncurry Φ) := Measurable.inner (hXm.comp measurable_fst) hnm
  have hk : ∀ s s' b, (∀ j < k, s j = s' j) → Φ s b = Φ s' b := by
    intro s s' b h
    simp only [Φ]
    rw [hXk s s' h, hYk s s' h]
  obtain ⟨hNi, -⟩ := noise_sq μ P hiid f g σ ho hgm k Y hYm hYk
  have hS : Measurable (fun s : ℕ → Ω => (s, s k)) := measurable_id.prodMk (measurable_pi_apply k)
  have hI : Integrable (fun s => Φ s (s k)) (P : Measure (ℕ → Ω)) := by
    refine (hX2.add hNi).mono' (hΦ.comp hS).aestronglyMeasurable
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun s => ?_))
    have h1 := abs_real_inner_le_norm (X s) (g (Y s) (s k) - gradient f (Y s))
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
    change |(inner ℝ (X s) (g (Y s) (s k) - gradient f (Y s)))| ≤ ‖X s‖ ^ 2 + ‖g (Y s) (s k) - gradient f (Y s)‖ ^ 2
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (‖X s‖ - ‖g (Y s) (s k) - gradient f (Y s)‖)]
  refine ⟨hI, ?_⟩
  rw [(RingmasterAsgd.step_integral μ P (fun k (s : ℕ → Ω) => s k) hiid k Φ hΦ hk).2 hI]
  have hz (s : ℕ → Ω) : (∫ b, Φ s b ∂(μ : Measure Ω)) = 0 := by
    change (∫ b, (inner ℝ (X s) (g (Y s) b - gradient f (Y s))) ∂(μ : Measure Ω)) = 0
    have hgi : Integrable (fun b => g (Y s) b - gradient f (Y s)) (μ : Measure Ω) :=
      (ho.integrable (Y s)).sub (integrable_const _)
    rw [integral_inner hgi, integral_sub (ho.integrable (Y s)) (integrable_const _), ho.unbiased]
    simp
  simp only [hz, integral_zero]

theorem batch_noise (μ : ProbabilityMeasure Ω) (P : ProbabilityMeasure (ℕ → Ω))
    (hiid : LongTails.Setups.StochasticGeneralizedSmoothAndConvex.IID (fun k (s : ℕ → Ω) => s k)
      (μ : Measure Ω) (P : Measure (ℕ → Ω)))
    (f : Mat m n → ℝ) (g : Mat m n → Ω → Mat m n) (σ : ℝ)
    (ho : LongTails.Setups.StochasticSmoothAndConvex.IsStochasticGradient (Mat m n) Ω (μ : Measure Ω) f g σ)
    (hgm : Measurable (gradient f)) (k0 : ℕ) (Y : (ℕ → Ω) → Mat m n) (hYm : Measurable Y)
    (hYk : ∀ s s', (∀ j < k0, s j = s' j) → Y s = Y s') (b : ℕ) :
    Measurable (fun s => ∑ j ∈ Finset.range b, (g (Y s) (s (k0 + j)) - gradient f (Y s))) ∧
    (∀ s s', (∀ j < k0 + b, s j = s' j) →
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.range b, (g (Y s) (s (k0 + j)) - gradient f (Y s)) =
        ∑ j ∈ Finset.range b, (g (Y s') (s' (k0 + j)) - gradient f (Y s'))) ∧
    Integrable (fun s => ‖∑ j ∈ Finset.range b, (g (Y s) (s (k0 + j)) - gradient f (Y s))‖ ^ 2)
      (P : Measure (ℕ → Ω)) ∧
    (∫ s, ‖∑ j ∈ Finset.range b, (g (Y s) (s (k0 + j)) - gradient f (Y s))‖ ^ 2
      ∂(P : Measure (ℕ → Ω))) ≤ b * σ ^ 2 := by
  induction b with
  | zero => simp
  | succ b ih =>
    obtain ⟨ihm, ihk, ihi, ihle⟩ := ih
    set S : (ℕ → Ω) → Mat m n := fun s => ∑ j ∈ Finset.range b, (g (Y s) (s (k0 + j)) - gradient f (Y s))
    have hYk' : ∀ s s', (∀ j < k0 + b, s j = s' j) → Y s = Y s' :=
      fun s s' h => hYk s s' (fun j hj => h j (by omega))
    obtain ⟨hci, hce⟩ := noise_cross μ P hiid f g σ ho hgm (k0 + b) S Y ihm hYm ihk hYk' ihi
    obtain ⟨hni, hnle⟩ := noise_sq μ P hiid f g σ ho hgm (k0 + b) Y hYm hYk'
    have hsplit : ∀ s, ‖∑ j ∈ Finset.range (b + 1), (g (Y s) (s (k0 + j)) - gradient f (Y s))‖ ^ 2 =
        ‖S s‖ ^ 2 + 2 * (inner ℝ (S s) (g (Y s) (s (k0 + b)) - gradient f (Y s))) +
          ‖g (Y s) (s (k0 + b)) - gradient f (Y s)‖ ^ 2 := by
      intro s
      rw [Finset.sum_range_succ, norm_add_sq_real]
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact Finset.measurable_sum _ (fun j _ =>
        (ho.measurable.comp (hYm.prodMk (measurable_pi_apply _))).sub (hgm.comp hYm))
    · intro s s' h
      rw [Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_succ, ihk s s' (fun j hj => h j (by omega)),
        hYk' s s' (fun j hj => h j (by omega)), h (k0 + b) (by omega)]
    · simp only [hsplit]
      exact (ihi.add (hci.const_mul 2)).add hni
    · simp only [hsplit]
      have hA : Integrable (fun s => ‖S s‖ ^ 2) (P : Measure (ℕ → Ω)) := ihi
      have hAle : (∫ s, ‖S s‖ ^ 2 ∂(P : Measure (ℕ → Ω))) ≤ b * σ ^ 2 := ihle
      have hB : Integrable (fun s => 2 * (inner ℝ (S s) (g (Y s) (s (k0 + b)) - gradient f (Y s))))
          (P : Measure (ℕ → Ω)) := hci.const_mul 2
      have hAB : Integrable (fun s => ‖S s‖ ^ 2 + 2 * (inner ℝ (S s) (g (Y s) (s (k0 + b)) - gradient f (Y s))))
          (P : Measure (ℕ → Ω)) := hA.add hB
      rw [integral_add hAB hni, integral_add hA hB, integral_const_mul, hce]
      push_cast
      linarith

theorem batch_mean_sub (B : ℕ) (hB : 1 ≤ B) (x : ℕ → Mat m n) (y : Mat m n) :
    (1 / (B : ℝ)) • ∑ j ∈ Finset.range B, x j - y = (1 / (B : ℝ)) • ∑ j ∈ Finset.range B, (x j - y) := by
  rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, smul_sub, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_range, ← Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul ℝ,
    smul_smul, one_div, inv_mul_cancel₀ (by exact_mod_cast (show B ≠ 0 by omega)), one_smul]

theorem momentum_noise (μ : ProbabilityMeasure Ω) (P : ProbabilityMeasure (ℕ → Ω))
    (hiid : LongTails.Setups.StochasticGeneralizedSmoothAndConvex.IID (fun k (s : ℕ → Ω) => s k)
      (μ : Measure Ω) (P : Measure (ℕ → Ω)))
    (f : Mat m n → ℝ) (g : Mat m n → Ω → Mat m n) (σ : ℝ)
    (ho : LongTails.Setups.StochasticSmoothAndConvex.IsStochasticGradient (Mat m n) Ω (μ : Measure Ω) f g σ)
    (hgm : Measurable (gradient f)) (β : ℝ) (hβ0 : 0 ≤ β) (hβ1 : β < 1) (B : ℕ) (hB : 1 ≤ B)
    (W : ℕ → (ℕ → Ω) → Mat m n) (hWm : ∀ t, Measurable (W t))
    (hWk : ∀ t s s', (∀ j < t * B, s j = s' j) → W t s = W t s')
    (D : ℕ → (ℕ → Ω) → Mat m n)
    (hD0 : ∀ s, D 0 s = (1 / (B : ℝ)) • ∑ j ∈ Finset.range B, g (W 0 s) (s (0 * B + j)) - gradient f (W 0 s))
    (hD : ∀ t s, D (t + 1) s = β • D t s + (1 - β) • ((1 / (B : ℝ)) •
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.range B, g (W (t + 1) s) (s ((t + 1) * B + j)) - gradient f (W (t + 1) s)))
    (t : ℕ) :
    Measurable (D t) ∧ (∀ s s', (∀ j < (t + 1) * B, s j = s' j) → D t s = D t s') ∧
    Integrable (fun s => ‖D t s‖ ^ 2) (P : Measure (ℕ → Ω)) ∧
    (∫ s, ‖D t s‖ ^ 2 ∂(P : Measure (ℕ → Ω))) ≤
      σ ^ 2 / B * ((1 - β) / (1 + β) + (1 - (1 - β) / (1 + β)) * β ^ (2 * t)) := by
  have hBpos : (0 : ℝ) < B := by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < B by omega)
  let N : ℕ → (ℕ → Ω) → Mat m n := fun t s =>
    (1 / (B : ℝ)) • ∑ j ∈ Finset.range B, (g (W t s) (s (t * B + j)) - gradient f (W t s))
  have hN : ∀ t s, (1 / (B : ℝ)) • ∑ j ∈ Finset.range B, g (W t s) (s (t * B + j)) - gradient f (W t s) =
      N t s := fun t s => batch_mean_sub B hB _ _
  have hNprops : ∀ t, Measurable (N t) ∧ (∀ s s', (∀ j < (t + 1) * B, s j = s' j) → N t s = N t s') ∧
      Integrable (fun s => ‖N t s‖ ^ 2) (P : Measure (ℕ → Ω)) ∧
      (∫ s, ‖N t s‖ ^ 2 ∂(P : Measure (ℕ → Ω))) ≤ σ ^ 2 / B := by
    intro t
    obtain ⟨hm, hk, hi, hle⟩ := batch_noise μ P hiid f g σ ho hgm (t * B) (W t) (hWm t) (hWk t) B
    have hsq : ∀ s, ‖N t s‖ ^ 2 = (1 / (B : ℝ)) ^ 2 *
        ‖∑ j ∈ Finset.range B, (g (W t s) (s (t * B + j)) - gradient f (W t s))‖ ^ 2 := by
      intro s
      simp only [N, norm_smul, mul_pow, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (one_div_pos.mpr hBpos)]
    refine ⟨Measurable.smul (measurable_const (a := (1 / (B : ℝ)))) hm, fun s s' h => ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simp only [N]
      rw [hk s s' (fun j hj => h j (by rw [add_mul, one_mul]; exact hj))]
    · simp only [hsq]
      exact hi.const_mul _
    · simp only [hsq]
      rw [integral_const_mul]
      calc (1 / (B : ℝ)) ^ 2 * ∫ s, ‖∑ j ∈ Finset.range B,
            (g (W t s) (s (t * B + j)) - gradient f (W t s))‖ ^ 2 ∂(P : Measure (ℕ → Ω)) ≤
            (1 / (B : ℝ)) ^ 2 * (B * σ ^ 2) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hle (sq_nonneg _)
        _ = σ ^ 2 / B := by field_simp
  have hcross : ∀ t, Measurable (D t) → (∀ s s', (∀ j < (t + 1) * B, s j = s' j) → D t s = D t s') →
      Integrable (fun s => ‖D t s‖ ^ 2) (P : Measure (ℕ → Ω)) →
      Integrable (fun s => (inner ℝ (D t s) (N (t + 1) s))) (P : Measure (ℕ → Ω)) ∧
        (∫ s, (inner ℝ (D t s) (N (t + 1) s)) ∂(P : Measure (ℕ → Ω))) = 0 := by
    intro t hm hk hi
    have hterm : ∀ j ∈ Finset.range B,
        Integrable (fun s => (inner ℝ (D t s) (g (W (t + 1) s) (s ((t + 1) * B + j)) - gradient f (W (t + 1) s))))
          (P : Measure (ℕ → Ω)) ∧
        (∫ s, (inner ℝ (D t s) (g (W (t + 1) s) (s ((t + 1) * B + j)) - gradient f (W (t + 1) s)))
          ∂(P : Measure (ℕ → Ω))) = 0 := by
      intro j _
      exact noise_cross μ P hiid f g σ ho hgm ((t + 1) * B + j) (D t) (W (t + 1)) hm (hWm (t + 1))
        (fun s s' h => hk s s' (fun i hi => h i (by omega)))
        (fun s s' h => hWk (t + 1) s s' (fun i hi => h i (by omega))) hi
    have hexp : ∀ s, (inner ℝ (D t s) (N (t + 1) s)) = (1 / (B : ℝ)) * ∑ j ∈ Finset.range B,
        (inner ℝ (D t s) (g (W (t + 1) s) (s ((t + 1) * B + j)) - gradient f (W (t + 1) s))) := by
      intro s
      simp only [N, inner_smul_right, inner_sum]
    simp only [hexp]
    refine ⟨(integrable_finsetSum _ (fun j hj => (hterm j hj).1)).const_mul _, ?_⟩
    rw [integral_const_mul, integral_finsetSum _ (fun j hj => (hterm j hj).1),
      Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun j hj => (hterm j hj).2), mul_zero]
  have h1b : 0 < 1 + β := by linarith
  have hrec_a : β ^ 2 * ((1 - β) / (1 + β)) + (1 - β) ^ 2 = (1 - β) / (1 + β) := by
    field_simp; ring
  induction t with
  | zero =>
    have e : D 0 = N 0 := funext fun s => by rw [hD0]; exact hN 0 s
    obtain ⟨hm, hk, hi, hle⟩ := hNprops 0
    rw [e]
    refine ⟨hm, hk, hi, hle.trans (le_of_eq ?_)⟩
    simp only [mul_zero, pow_zero, mul_one]
    ring
  | succ t ih =>
    obtain ⟨hm, hk, hi, hle⟩ := ih
    obtain ⟨hNm, hNk, hNi, hNle⟩ := hNprops (t + 1)
    obtain ⟨hci, hce⟩ := hcross t hm hk hi
    have e : D (t + 1) = fun s => β • D t s + (1 - β) • N (t + 1) s :=
      funext fun s => by rw [hD, hN]
    have hb1 : 0 ≤ 1 - β := by linarith
    have hsq : ∀ s, ‖β • D t s + (1 - β) • N (t + 1) s‖ ^ 2 = β ^ 2 * ‖D t s‖ ^ 2 +
        2 * (β * (1 - β)) * (inner ℝ (D t s) (N (t + 1) s)) + (1 - β) ^ 2 * ‖N (t + 1) s‖ ^ 2 := by
      intro s
      rw [norm_add_sq_real, norm_smul, norm_smul, inner_smul_left, inner_smul_right, Real.norm_eq_abs,
        Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hβ0, abs_of_nonneg hb1, conj_trivial]
      ring
    rw [e]
    have hA : Integrable (fun s => β ^ 2 * ‖D t s‖ ^ 2) (P : Measure (ℕ → Ω)) := hi.const_mul _
    have hB : Integrable (fun s => 2 * (β * (1 - β)) * (inner ℝ (D t s) (N (t + 1) s))) (P : Measure (ℕ → Ω)) :=
      hci.const_mul _
    have hC : Integrable (fun s => (1 - β) ^ 2 * ‖N (t + 1) s‖ ^ 2) (P : Measure (ℕ → Ω)) :=
      hNi.const_mul _
    have hAB : Integrable (fun s => β ^ 2 * ‖D t s‖ ^ 2 + 2 * (β * (1 - β)) * (inner ℝ (D t s) (N (t + 1) s)))
        (P : Measure (ℕ → Ω)) := hA.add hB
    refine ⟨by fun_prop, fun s s' h => ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simp only
      rw [hk s s' (fun j hj => h j (by nlinarith)), hNk s s' h]
    · simp only [hsq]
      exact hAB.add hC
    · simp only [hsq]
      rw [integral_add hAB hC, integral_add hA hB, integral_const_mul, integral_const_mul,
        integral_const_mul, hce]
      have hσ : 0 ≤ σ ^ 2 / B := by positivity
      have h1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hle (sq_nonneg β)
      have h2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hNle (sq_nonneg (1 - β))
      have hpow : β ^ (2 * (t + 1)) = β ^ 2 * β ^ (2 * t) := by ring
      rw [hpow]
      nlinarith [hrec_a]

omit [MeasurableSpace Ω] in
theorem integral_norm_le_sqrt {mΞ : MeasurableSpace Ω} (Q : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure Q]
    (X : Ω → Mat m n) (hXm : Measurable X) (hX2 : Integrable (fun s => ‖X s‖ ^ 2) Q) :
    Integrable (fun s => ‖X s‖) Q ∧ (∫ s, ‖X s‖ ∂Q) ≤ Real.sqrt (∫ s, ‖X s‖ ^ 2 ∂Q) := by
  have hI : Integrable (fun s => ‖X s‖) Q := by
    refine ((hX2.add (integrable_const 1)).div_const 2).mono' hXm.norm.aestronglyMeasurable
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun s => ?_))
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (norm_nonneg _)]
    change ‖X s‖ ≤ (‖X s‖ ^ 2 + 1) / 2
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (‖X s‖ - 1)]
  refine ⟨hI, ?_⟩
  set c := ∫ s, ‖X s‖ ∂Q
  have hc0 : 0 ≤ c := integral_nonneg (fun s => norm_nonneg _)
  have hexp : ∀ s, (‖X s‖ - c) ^ 2 = ‖X s‖ ^ 2 - 2 * c * ‖X s‖ + c ^ 2 := fun s => by ring
  have hnn : 0 ≤ ∫ s, (‖X s‖ - c) ^ 2 ∂Q := integral_nonneg (fun s => sq_nonneg _)
  have hA : Integrable (fun s => ‖X s‖ ^ 2 - 2 * c * ‖X s‖) Q := hX2.sub (hI.const_mul _)
  simp only [hexp] at hnn
  rw [integral_add hA (integrable_const _), integral_sub hX2 (hI.const_mul _), integral_const_mul,
    integral_const, probReal_univ, one_smul] at hnn
  rw [Real.le_sqrt hc0 (integral_nonneg (fun s => sq_nonneg _))]
  nlinarith

theorem momentum_sqrt_le (β : ℝ) (hβ0 : 0 ≤ β) (hβ1 : β < 1) (y : ℝ) (hy0 : 0 ≤ y) (hy1 : y ≤ 1) :
    Real.sqrt ((1 - β) / (1 + β) + (1 - (1 - β) / (1 + β)) * y ^ 2) ≤
      Real.sqrt ((1 - β) / (1 + β)) + β * y := by
  set a := (1 - β) / (1 + β)
  have h1b : 0 < 1 + β := by linarith
  have ha0 : 0 ≤ a := div_nonneg (by linarith) h1b.le
  set q := Real.sqrt a
  have hq0 : 0 ≤ q := Real.sqrt_nonneg a
  have hqq : q ^ 2 = a := Real.sq_sqrt ha0
  have h1a : 1 - a = 2 * β / (1 + β) := by simp only [a]; field_simp; ring
  have hkey : q * (2 + β) ≤ 2 := by
    have hsq : (q * (2 + β)) ^ 2 ≤ 2 ^ 2 := by
      rw [mul_pow, hqq]
      simp only [a]
      rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, div_le_iff₀ h1b]
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg β, mul_nonneg hβ0 (sq_nonneg β)]
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (q * (2 + β) - 2), sq_nonneg (q * (2 + β) + 2), mul_nonneg hq0 (by linarith : (0:ℝ) ≤ 2 + β)]
  have hcoef : 1 - a - β ^ 2 ≤ 2 * q * β := by
    have : 1 - a - β ^ 2 = β * (a * (2 + β)) := by
      rw [h1a]; simp only [a]; field_simp; ring
    rw [this, ← hqq]
    nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hkey (mul_nonneg hβ0 hq0)]
  rw [Real.sqrt_le_left (by positivity)]
  rw [← hqq] at hcoef ⊢
  have : (1 - q ^ 2 - β ^ 2) * y ≤ 2 * q * β := by
    rcases le_total 0 (1 - q ^ 2 - β ^ 2) with h | h
    · nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hy1 h]
    · nlinarith [mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hq0 hβ0) (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) ≤ 2), mul_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg h hy0]
  nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left this hy0]

end OracleTemplate.Muon

import LongTails.Proofs.MuonExecution
import LongTails.Setups.MuonThirdOrder
import Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.MeanValue
import Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.Deriv.MeanValue

open MeasureTheory
open scoped RealInnerProductSpace

namespace OracleTemplate.Muon

variable {m n : ℕ}

theorem hessian_diff_bound (f : Mat m n → ℝ) (s : ℝ)
    (hd3 : Differentiable ℝ (iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 f))
    (h : ∀ W U V X, |iteratedFDeriv ℝ 3 f W ![U, V, X]| ≤ s * ‖U‖ * ‖V‖ * ‖X‖)
    (W D : Mat m n) (τ : ℝ) (hτ : 0 ≤ τ) :
    |fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) (W + τ • D) D D - fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) W D D| ≤ s * ‖D‖ ^ 3 * τ := by
  set G := iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 f
  have hline : ∀ u : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun u : ℝ => W + u • D) D u := fun u => by
    simpa using ((hasDerivAt_id u).smul_const D).const_add W
  have hg : ∀ u, HasDerivAt (fun u : ℝ => G (W + u • D) ![D, D])
      (iteratedFDeriv ℝ 3 f (W + u • D) ![D, D, D]) u := by
    intro u
    have hc := (hd3 (W + u • D)).hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt u (hline u)
    have he := (ContinuousMultilinearMap.apply ℝ (fun _ : Fin 2 => Mat m n) ℝ ![D, D]).hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt u hc
    have e : iteratedFDeriv ℝ 3 f (W + u • D) ![D, D, D] = fderiv ℝ G (W + u • D) D ![D, D] := by
      rw [iteratedFDeriv_succ_apply_left]
      rfl
    rw [e]
    exact he
  have hb := norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_deriv_le_segment' (f := fun u : ℝ => G (W + u • D) ![D, D])
    (a := 0) (b := τ) (C := s * ‖D‖ ^ 3) (fun u _ => (hg u).hasDerivWithinAt)
    (fun u _ => by
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
      have := h (W + u • D) D D D
      calc _ ≤ s * ‖D‖ * ‖D‖ * ‖D‖ := this
        _ = s * ‖D‖ ^ 3 := by ring) τ (Set.right_mem_Icc.2 hτ)
  simp only [zero_smul, add_zero, sub_zero, Real.norm_eq_abs] at hb
  have e2 : ∀ y, G y ![D, D] = fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) y D D := fun y => by
    rw [iteratedFDeriv_two_apply]
    rfl
  rw [e2, e2] at hb
  exact hb

theorem taylor_third (f : Mat m n → ℝ) (s : ℝ) (hd1 : Differentiable ℝ f)
    (hd2 : Differentiable ℝ (fderiv ℝ f)) (hd3 : Differentiable ℝ (iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 f))
    (h : ∀ W U V X, |iteratedFDeriv ℝ 3 f W ![U, V, X]| ≤ s * ‖U‖ * ‖V‖ * ‖X‖) (W D : Mat m n) :
    f (W + D) ≤ f W + fderiv ℝ f W D + fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) W D D / 2 + s * ‖D‖ ^ 3 / 6 := by
  set F1 := fderiv ℝ f
  set F2 := fderiv ℝ F1
  set c := s * ‖D‖ ^ 3
  have hline : ∀ τ : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun τ : ℝ => W + τ • D) D τ := fun τ => by
    simpa using ((hasDerivAt_id τ).smul_const D).const_add W
  have h1 : ∀ τ, HasDerivAt (fun τ : ℝ => f (W + τ • D)) (F1 (W + τ • D) D) τ := fun τ =>
    (hd1 (W + τ • D)).hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt τ (hline τ)
  have h2 : ∀ τ, HasDerivAt (fun τ : ℝ => F1 (W + τ • D) D) (F2 (W + τ • D) D D) τ := by
    intro τ
    have hc := (hd2 (W + τ • D)).hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt τ (hline τ)
    have := hc.clm_apply (hasDerivAt_const τ D)
    simpa using this
  let ψ : ℝ → ℝ := fun τ => F1 (W + τ • D) D - F1 W D - τ * F2 W D D - c * τ ^ 2 / 2
  have hψ : ∀ τ, HasDerivAt ψ (F2 (W + τ • D) D D - 1 * F2 W D D - c * (2 * τ) / 2) τ := by
    intro τ
    have := (((h2 τ).sub_const (F1 W D)).sub ((hasDerivAt_id τ).mul_const (F2 W D D))).sub
      (((hasDerivAt_pow 2 τ).const_mul c).div_const 2)
    convert this using 1
    · rfl
    · simp
  have hψle : ∀ τ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, F2 (W + τ • D) D D - 1 * F2 W D D - c * (2 * τ) / 2 ≤ 0 := by
    intro τ hτ
    have hl := hessian_diff_bound f s hd3 h W D τ hτ.1
    have : c * (2 * τ) / 2 = s * ‖D‖ ^ 3 * τ := by simp only [c]; ring
    linarith [le_abs_self (F2 (W + τ • D) D D - F2 W D D)]
  have hψanti : AntitoneOn ψ (Set.Icc 0 1) :=
    antitoneOn_of_hasDerivWithinAt_nonpos (convex_Icc 0 1)
      (fun τ _ => (hψ τ).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt) (fun τ _ => (hψ τ).hasDerivWithinAt)
      (fun τ hτ => hψle τ (Set.Ioo_subset_Icc_self (by rwa [interior_Icc] at hτ)))
  have hψ0 : ψ 0 = 0 := by simp [ψ]
  let φ : ℝ → ℝ := fun τ => f (W + τ • D) - τ * F1 W D - τ ^ 2 / 2 * F2 W D D - c * τ ^ 3 / 6
  have hφ : ∀ τ, HasDerivAt φ (F1 (W + τ • D) D - 1 * F1 W D - (2 * τ) / 2 * F2 W D D - c * (3 * τ ^ 2) / 6) τ := by
    intro τ
    have := ((((h1 τ).sub ((hasDerivAt_id τ).mul_const (F1 W D))).sub
      (((hasDerivAt_pow 2 τ).div_const 2).mul_const (F2 W D D))).sub
      (((hasDerivAt_pow 3 τ).const_mul c).div_const 6))
    convert this using 1
    · rfl
    · simp
  have hφanti : AntitoneOn φ (Set.Icc 0 1) := by
    refine antitoneOn_of_hasDerivWithinAt_nonpos (convex_Icc 0 1)
      (fun τ _ => (hφ τ).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt) (fun τ _ => (hφ τ).hasDerivWithinAt)
      (fun τ hτ => ?_)
    rw [interior_Icc] at hτ
    have hle := hψanti (Set.left_mem_Icc.2 zero_le_one) (Set.Ioo_subset_Icc_self hτ) hτ.1.le
    rw [hψ0] at hle
    have : F1 (W + τ • D) D - 1 * F1 W D - (2 * τ) / 2 * F2 W D D - c * (3 * τ ^ 2) / 6 = ψ τ := by
      simp only [ψ]; ring
    linarith
  have := hφanti (Set.left_mem_Icc.2 zero_le_one) (Set.right_mem_Icc.2 zero_le_one) zero_le_one
  have e0 : φ 0 = f W := by simp [φ]
  have e1 : φ 1 = f (W + D) - F1 W D - F2 W D D / 2 - c / 6 := by simp only [φ, one_smul]; ring
  rw [e0, e1] at this
  simp only [c] at this
  linarith

theorem exists_le_of_average_le (T : ℕ) (hT : 1 ≤ T) (a : Fin T → ℝ) (ε : ℝ)
    (h : (1 / (T : ℝ)) * ∑ t, a t ≤ ε) : ∃ t, a t ≤ ε := by
  have hTpos : (0 : ℝ) < T := by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < T by omega)
  have hne : (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin T)).Nonempty := ⟨⟨0, by omega⟩, Finset.mem_univ _⟩
  have hs : ∑ t, a t ≤ ∑ _t : Fin T, ε := by
    rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul]
    rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, one_mul, div_le_iff₀ hTpos] at h
    linarith
  obtain ⟨t, -, ht⟩ := Finset.exists_le_of_sum_le hne hs
  exact ⟨t, ht⟩

theorem fderiv_eq_inner_gradient (f : Mat m n → ℝ) (W P : Mat m n) :
    fderiv ℝ f W P = ⟪gradient f W, P⟫ := by
  change fderiv ℝ f W P = (inner ℝ ((InnerProductSpace.toDual ℝ (Mat m n)).symm (fderiv ℝ f W)) (P))
  rw [InnerProductSpace.toDual_symm_apply]

theorem third_step (f : Mat m n → ℝ) (s η : ℝ) (hs : 0 ≤ s) (hη : 0 ≤ η)
    (hf : LongTails.Setups.MuonThirdOrder.ThirdDerivativeBounded s f) (W : Mat m n) :
    f (W - η • orthogonalize (gradient f W)) ≤ f W - η * nuclearNorm (gradient f W) +
      η ^ 2 * LongTails.Setups.MuonThirdOrder.hessianQuadratic f W / 2 +
      s * η ^ 3 * (((min m n : ℕ) : ℝ) * Real.sqrt ((min m n : ℕ) : ℝ)) / 6 := by
  obtain ⟨hd1, hd2, hd3, h⟩ := hf
  set P := orthogonalize (gradient f W)
  have ht := taylor_third f s hd1 hd2 hd3 h W (-(η • P))
  rw [← sub_eq_add_neg] at ht
  have e1 : fderiv ℝ f W (-(η • P)) = -(η * nuclearNorm (gradient f W)) := by
    rw [map_neg, map_smul, fderiv_eq_inner_gradient, inner_orthogonalize, smul_eq_mul]
  have e2 : fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) W (-(η • P)) (-(η • P)) =
      η ^ 2 * LongTails.Setups.MuonThirdOrder.hessianQuadratic f W := by
    have hq : LongTails.Setups.MuonThirdOrder.hessianQuadratic f W = fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) W P P := by
      change iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 f W ![P, P] = _
      rw [iteratedFDeriv_two_apply]
      rfl
    rw [hq]
    simp
    ring
  have hP : ‖P‖ ≤ Real.sqrt ((min m n : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
    rw [Real.le_sqrt (norm_nonneg _) (Nat.cast_nonneg _)]; exact norm_orthogonalize_sq_le _
  have e3 : ‖-(η • P)‖ ^ 3 ≤ η ^ 3 * (((min m n : ℕ) : ℝ) * Real.sqrt ((min m n : ℕ) : ℝ)) := by
    rw [norm_neg, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hη, mul_pow]
    have hr := Real.mul_self_sqrt (Nat.cast_nonneg (min m n) : (0:ℝ) ≤ ((min m n : ℕ) : ℝ))
    have h3 : ‖P‖ ^ 3 ≤ Real.sqrt ((min m n : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 3 := pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) hP 3
    have : Real.sqrt ((min m n : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 3 = ((min m n : ℕ) : ℝ) * Real.sqrt ((min m n : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
      rw [pow_succ, sq, hr]
    rw [← this]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h3 (by positivity)
  rw [e1, e2] at ht
  nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left e3 hs]

end OracleTemplate.Muon

namespace OracleTemplate.MuonThirdOrder

open Muon LongTails.Setups.MuonThirdOrder

theorem guarantee (p : Params) (hp : spec.valid p) (f : Mat p.m p.n → ℝ)
    (hf : ThirdDerivativeBounded p.s f) (hb : BddBelow (Set.range f)) :
    Guarantee p f (fun j : Fin (p.T + 1) => SimplifiedMuon.trajectory (publicInput p) (gradient f) j) := by
  obtain ⟨hm, hn, hs, hη, hT⟩ := hp
  set W : ℕ → Mat p.m p.n := fun t => SimplifiedMuon.trajectory (publicInput p) (gradient f) t
  set r : ℝ := ((min p.m p.n : ℕ) : ℝ)
  set T : ℝ := (p.T : ℝ)
  have hTpos : 0 < T := Nat.cast_pos.mpr (by omega)
  have hsucc : ∀ t, W (t + 1) = W t - p.η • orthogonalize (gradient f (W t)) := fun t =>
    Function.iterate_succ_apply' _ _ _
  have hW0 : W 0 = p.W0 := rfl
  set c : ℝ := p.s * p.η ^ 3 * (r * Real.sqrt r) / 6
  have hstep : ∀ t, p.η * nuclearNorm (gradient f (W t)) ≤ f (W t) - f (W (t + 1)) +
      p.η ^ 2 * hessianQuadratic f (W t) / 2 + c := by
    intro t
    have := third_step f p.s p.η hs hη.le hf (W t)
    rw [← hsucc] at this
    have hc : c = p.s * p.η ^ 3 * (((min p.m p.n : ℕ) : ℝ) * Real.sqrt ((min p.m p.n : ℕ) : ℝ)) / 6 := rfl
    linarith
  have hsum := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun t (_ : t ∈ Finset.range p.T) => hstep t)
  rw [← Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_add_distrib,
    Finset.sum_range_sub' (fun t => f (W t)), ← Finset.sum_div, ← Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_const,
    Finset.card_range, nsmul_eq_mul] at hsum
  set A := ∑ t ∈ Finset.range p.T, nuclearNorm (gradient f (W t))
  set H := ∑ t ∈ Finset.range p.T, hessianQuadratic f (W t)
  have hA : (1 / T) * ∑ t : Fin p.T, nuclearNorm (gradient f (W t.castSucc)) = (1 / T) * A := by
    simp only [Fin.val_castSucc, A]
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range (fun t => nuclearNorm (gradient f (W t))) p.T]
  have hH : (1 / T) * ∑ t : Fin p.T, hessianQuadratic f (W t.castSucc) = (1 / T) * H := by
    simp only [Fin.val_castSucc, H]
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range (fun t => hessianQuadratic f (W t)) p.T]
  have hmain : (1 / T) * A ≤ (f (W 0) - f (W p.T)) / (T * p.η) + p.η * ((1 / T) * H) / 2 +
      p.s * p.η ^ 2 * (r * Real.sqrt r) / 6 := by
    have e : (f (W 0) - f (W p.T)) / (T * p.η) + p.η * ((1 / T) * H) / 2 +
        p.s * p.η ^ 2 * (r * Real.sqrt r) / 6 =
        (f (W 0) - f (W p.T) + p.η ^ 2 * H / 2 + T * c) / (T * p.η) := by
      simp only [c]; field_simp; try ring
    rw [e, le_div_iff₀ (mul_pos hTpos hη)]
    have : 1 / T * A * (T * p.η) = p.η * A := by field_simp
    rw [this]
    linarith
  set Δ := f p.W0 - ⨅ W, f W
  have hgap : f (W 0) - f (W p.T) ≤ Δ := by
    have := ciInf_le hb (W p.T)
    rw [hW0]
    change f p.W0 - f (W p.T) ≤ f p.W0 - ⨅ W, f W
    linarith
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hA, hH]
    exact hmain
  · intro hJ hηdef
    rw [hA]
    rw [hH] at hJ hηdef ⊢
    set J := (1 / T) * H
    have hΔ : 0 < Δ := by
      by_contra hc
      have : 2 * Δ / (J * T) ≤ 0 :=
        div_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg (by linarith [not_lt.mp hc]) (by positivity)
      rw [hηdef, Real.sqrt_eq_zero'.mpr this] at hη
      exact lt_irrefl _ hη
    have hη2 : p.η ^ 2 = 2 * Δ / (J * T) := by
      rw [hηdef, Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)]
    have hk : p.η * J / 2 = Δ / (T * p.η) := by
      rw [eq_div_iff (by positivity)]
      have : p.η * J / 2 * (T * p.η) = p.η ^ 2 * J * T / 2 := by ring
      rw [this, hη2]; field_simp
    have hηJ : p.η * J = Real.sqrt (2 * J * Δ / T) := by
      rw [eq_comm, Real.sqrt_eq_iff_mul_self_eq (by positivity) (by positivity)]
      have : p.η * J * (p.η * J) = p.η ^ 2 * J ^ 2 := by ring
      rw [this, hη2]; field_simp; try ring
    have hlast : p.s * p.η ^ 2 * (r * Real.sqrt r) / 6 = p.s * (r * Real.sqrt r) * Δ / (3 * J * T) := by
      rw [hη2]; field_simp; try ring
    have h1 : (f (W 0) - f (W p.T)) / (T * p.η) ≤ Δ / (T * p.η) :=
      div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hgap (by positivity)
    have hbound : (1 / T) * A ≤ Real.sqrt (2 * J * Δ / T) + p.s * (r * Real.sqrt r) * Δ / (3 * J * T) := by
      have : p.η * J / 2 + p.η * J / 2 = p.η * J := by ring
      linarith
    refine ⟨hbound, fun ε hε h8 h2 => ?_⟩
    have hq1 : Real.sqrt (2 * J * Δ / T) ≤ ε / 2 := by
      rw [Real.sqrt_le_left (by positivity), div_le_iff₀ hTpos]
      rw [div_le_iff₀ (by positivity)] at h8
      nlinarith
    have hq2 : p.s * (r * Real.sqrt r) * Δ / (3 * J * T) ≤ ε / 2 := by
      rw [div_le_iff₀ (by positivity)]
      rw [div_le_iff₀ (by positivity)] at h2
      nlinarith
    have havgε : (1 / T) * A ≤ ε := by linarith
    refine ⟨havgε, ?_⟩
    exact exists_le_of_average_le p.T hT (fun t => nuclearNorm (gradient f (W t.castSucc))) ε
      (hA.trans_le havgε)

end OracleTemplate.MuonThirdOrder

tune.source:
import LongTails.Algorithms.Muon
import Mathlib.Probability.Distributions.Uniform

open MeasureTheory

namespace outputs.Algorithms.MuonTuning

open OracleTemplate OracleTemplate.Muon

structure Public where
  m : ℕ
  n : ℕ
  L : ℝ
  σ : ℝ
  Δ : ℝ
  ε : ℝ
  W0 : Mat m n

noncomputable def threshold (p : Public) (C : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  let r : ℝ := (min p.m p.n : ℕ)
  18 ^ 4 * r * C * p.Δ * p.σ ^ 2 / p.ε ^ 4 + 18 ^ 2 * C * p.Δ / p.ε ^ 2 +
    18 ^ 2 * r ^ 2 * p.σ ^ 4 / (C * p.Δ * p.ε ^ 2)

noncomputable def horizon (p : Public) (C : ℝ) : ℕ := ⌈threshold p C⌉₊ + 1

noncomputable def momentum (p : Public) (C : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  1 - (if p.σ = 0 then 1 else
    min (Real.sqrt (C * p.Δ) / (p.σ * Real.sqrt (((min p.m p.n : ℕ) : ℝ) * horizon p C))) 1)

import outputs.Algorithms.MuonTuning
import LongTails.Proofs.MuonNonconvex

open MeasureTheory

namespace outputs.Proofs.MuonTuning

open OracleTemplate OracleTemplate.Muon

open outputs.Algorithms.MuonTuning

theorem tuning_bounds (p : outputs.Algorithms.MuonTuning.Public) (C : ℝ)
    (hm : 0 < p.m) (hn : 0 < p.n) (hC : 0 < C) (hΔ : 0 < p.Δ)
    (hε : 0 < p.ε) (hσ : 0 ≤ p.σ) :
    0 ≤ momentum p C ∧ momentum p C < 1 ∧ 0 < stepSize p C ∧
    1 ≤ horizon p C ∧ threshold p C ≤ (horizon p C : ℝ) := by sorry

theorem scalar_accuracy (p : outputs.Algorithms.MuonTuning.Public) (C E : ℝ)
    (hm : 0 < p.m) (hn : 0 < p.n) (hC : 0 < C) (hΔ : 0 < p.Δ)
    (hε : 0 < p.ε) (hσ : 0 ≤ p.σ) (hE : E ≤ p.Δ) :
    let r : ℝ := (min p.m p.n : ℕ)
    let K : ℝ := horizon p C
    let β := momentum p C
    let η := stepSize p C
    E / (K * η) + C * η / 2 + 2 * p.σ * Real.sqrt (r * (1 - β)) / Real.sqrt (1 + β) +
      2 * β * p.σ * Real.sqrt r / ((1 - β) * K) + 2 * η * β * C / (1 - β) ≤ p.ε := by sorry

end outputs.Proofs.MuonTuning

src_0a22465fda7cb531e4b13a15.quote: Although commonly used optimizers for training deep neural networks, such as SGD, Adam \citep{diederik2014adam}, and AdamW \citep{loshchilov2017decoupled}, typically treat structured parameters (e.g., matrices) as flattened vectors, however, in recent years, there has been growing interest in designing structured optimizers that explicitly leverage the inherent structure of parameters. For instance, Adafactor \citep{shazeer2018adafactor}, LAMB \citep{you2019large}, and Adam-mini \citep{zhang2024adam} incorporate matrix- or layer-level structure to reduce memory consumption. KFAC \citep{martens2015optimizing} and TNT \citep{ren2021tensor} approximate the Fisher matrix to implement natural gradient methods. Shampoo \citep{gupta2018shampoo} is specifically designed for matrix or tensor parameters and can be viewed as an approximation to the full-matrix preconditioner in AdaGrad \citep{duchi2011adaptive}.  \cite{morwani2024new} provided additional theoretical analyses and modifications to Shampoo. Recently, SOAP \citep{vyas2024soap} was introduced, which combines the ideas of Adam and Shampoo. Galore \citep{zhao2024galore} was proposed to exploit the low-rank structure of gradients for memory efficiency. Additionally, \cite{liu2025cosmos} proposed COSMOS, which can be seen as a combination of SOAP and Muon. More recently, \cite{xie2025structured} and \cite{an2025asgo} introduced ASGO (One-Sided Shampoo), which only applies a one-sided preconditioner within the Shampoo. \cite{xie2025structured, an2025asgo} showed that ASGO(One-Sided Shampoo) can achieve better convergence rate than the original Shampoo.

src_13adb375724e48852149793b.quote: The majority of parameters in neural networks are naturally represented as matrices. However, most commonly used optimizers treat these matrix parameters as flattened vectors during optimization, potentially overlooking their inherent structural properties. Recently, an optimizer called Muon has been proposed, specifically designed to optimize matrix-structured parameters. Extensive empirical evidence shows that Muon can significantly outperform traditional optimizers when training neural networks. Nonetheless, the theoretical understanding of Muon’s convergence behavior and the reasons behind its superior performance remain limited. In this work, we present a comprehensive convergence rate analysis of Muon and its comparison with Gradient Descent (GD). We further characterize the conditions under which Muon can outperform GD. Our theoretical results reveal that Muon can benefit from the low-rank and approximate blockwise diagonal structure of Hessian matrices -- phenomena widely observed in practical neural network training. Our experimental results support and corroborate the theoretical findings.
